articleTitle: Substantiation of On-Line Monitoring Methods for Surge Arrestors of Closed 110 kV Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: High voltage nonlinear surge arrestors (HVSA) are electrical devices designed to protect the equipment of power supply systems from switching and lightning overvoltages. The article considers the HVSA installed in closed 110 kV switchgears of the furnace-ladle units at the metallurgical plants. It is highlighted that the impact of external factors may cause loss of the arrestor's sealing thus making it not suitable for use. In this connection, the development of methods and systems for monitoring the HSV A technical state is relevant. The analysis of known methods for frequent control is provided with their advantages and disadvantages described. The significance of HVSA thermal imaging control is emphasized. The results of frequent measurements are further provided. It is shown that due to the complexity of the device design, thermal imaging control cannot provide a reliable measurement of the temperature at the surfaces of voltage-variable resistors. The requirements towards the HVSA on-line monitoring system are stated. According to them, one shall conduct a continuous monitoring of the thermal state of each HVSA section and also the monitoring of the root-mean-square values of the harmonic components of the conductive currents in each phase.

articleTitle: The Internet of Things System to Prevent Gantry Crane Collisions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of radioelectronic systems and information technology affected the development of logistics and cargo carriage all over the world. The capacity of continuous position control using navigation and planning control helped accelerate cargo delivery operations. However, accidents at sorting stations significantly increase goods delivery times resulting in large economic losses. The introduction of industrial Internet of Things systems to automate and control sorting, unloading, and loading is one of the solutions to this problem. In this article, the authors review the possibility of integrating industrial Internet of Things solutions to prevent gantry crane collisions at soring stations during high humidity and fog. The authors compare the existing gantry crate collision prevention systems. During this work, some hardware and software solutions have been developed to detect obstacles in the crane's way and prevent emergencies. The information about obstacles is transmitted over a radio channel to the crane control module. The visualization of obstacles in the crane's way is implemented using a MQTT server. A built-in temperature and humidity sensor helped reduce the distance-to-object measurement error. The experiments on a laboratory prototype confirmed the efficiency of using industrial Internet of Things platforms for the prevention of gantry crane collisions.

articleTitle: Wireless Degassing Sensor for the Industrial Internet of Things in Heating Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Improving the reliability and efficiency of heating and water supply systems in industrial and housing utility services is an important problem for countries with uncertain climates and severe temperature changes. Temperature changes impact the pressure ratio in the pipe and the surroundings, which may lead to pipe break due to the presence of an airvapor mixture in the heat carrier medium. Removing air from pipelines is required by the operating procedures of heating systems. Currently, this is done in the main and distribution heating systems and it is usually performed manually. During the manual removal of air, some of the heat carrier medium is discharged as well. The manual technology makes maintaining a low content of air within the system throughout the entire heating and repair periods practically impossible. Using an automated air valve to optimize the operation of heating systems, as well as direct and reverse heating water pipelines with a software package allows for the monitoring of the air content, prompt decision-making, and detection of pre-emergencies. This article analyzes the use of wireless sensors and real-time data transfer methods for smart city systems. The authors suggest integrating technological solutions and Industrial Internet of Things systems to monitor the air content in heating system pipelines. Authors developed a wireless air content sensor for heating and water supply systems. To visualize and protect the transferred data, there are data transfer algorithms for the local network and the MQTT server.

articleTitle: A New Brushless Non-salient Pole Generator with Multi-pole Rotor for Direct-drive Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Wind turbines provide up to 10% of all electricity in Europe, making a significant contribution to save the ecology. In case of high reliability of wind turbines and low maintenance, the cost of electricity can be lower than that of fossil fuel power plants or nuclear power plants. A new type of brushless monopolar generators with a field winding on the stator provides a simple design and high reliability due to the absence of rings and brushes on the rotor. One of the ways to improve reliability is to exclude the gearbox from the design of the wind turbine, but this leads to a decrease in rotational speed of generator's rotor. This article describes the design of the multi-pole brushless generator for use at infra-low rotor speed of 25 rpm. The output frequency of 50 Hz allows to work directly on the load and through a converter, while the dimensions of such a generator itself stay the same.

articleTitle: The Cutting Tool Technical State Forecasting During the Technological Production Preparation Stages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This study deals with the addressing the issue of ensuring the operational condition of the technological system in terms of quality parameters for manufacturing products within the required timeframe by developing and implementing the method for forecasting the technical state of the cutting tool (CT). The paper highlights the importance of determining and forecasting the technical state of the CT for enterprises in the instrument-making and mechanical engineering industries. To address the research question, an operational control method for the CT, based on the multisensory data fusion obtained from technical diagnostic and control systems on a computer numerical control (CNC) machine, was proposed. The forecasting of the CT's technical state was performed using artificial intelligence (AI) methods. The proposed approach for obtaining input data for developing predictive models differs in their reliability due to minimizing erroneous results from individual technical diagnostic and control systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of the Geometric Dimensions of Permanent Magnets on the Magnitude of the Back Electromotive Force in Synchronous Machines with Sensorless Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The current publication examines how the geometric parameters of permanent magnets in electric motors with permanent magnets affect the back electromotive force (EMF). Understanding this reverse EMF is crucial for regulating the motor's dynamics based on magnet properties. Investigating the influence of magnet geometry on the reverse EMF and motor speed is crucial in light of rapid advances in electric drive technologies. With new materials and design approaches emerging, there is a need to better understand how magnet parameters affect motor characteristics. By systematically modifying the magnet's geometric parameters, we aim to identify specific changes that cause variations in the reverse EMF and motor speed. This study is valuable for developing efficient electric drives that meet performance standards. Consequently, our article focuses on exploring the relationship between magnet geometry, reverse EMF, and motor speed. We anticipate that the findings will enhance understanding of how magnet parameters impact electric motor performance and contribute to the development of more efficient drive systems.

articleTitle: Data Acquisition from Relay Protection Systems with the Possibility of Displaying and Analyzing on Remote Workplaces
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this article analyzed the ways of receiving data from power system protection, identified 3 standard communication protocols (MMS, GOOSE, SV), and considered 2 additional ones (TCP, UDP) for interaction with API systems and one auxiliary one for environmental sensors (MQTT). The development methods were divided into preliminary (parsing and fast Fourier transform) and deep analysis (neural networks). A functional model of Network Analytics was developed, which described the interrelationships between the individual components of the system and the technology stack used: Java Spring, Python, Vue.js, MQTT. Based on the functional model, the architecture of the system was drawn up with a division into local and remote parts. Local - single-board or industrial PC with the ability to support the channel up to 100 MB/s, connection of peripherals and 3GB of memory (for 2–3 months of autonomous registration of accidents). Remote - a server with 2TB of memory and the ability to connect 5 engineers and one system administrator. For the test, a laboratory bench was developed that processed pre-collected data from the power protection relays. This data was visualized by means of web screens, on which it was possible to analyze the causes of alarm situation

articleTitle: Effect of Partial Shading on the Efficiency of Solar Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analytical review of the investigated topic, including advantages and disadvantages of existing works on the topic of research, description of libraries used for modeling the 1- V curve of the photovoltaic array, including PVLIB Python library and its modules. Also includes the definition of the condition of the experiment, description of the problem and conditions, as well as step-by-step methodology for modeling the I-V curve of the photovoltaic array of the conducted research. The conclusion summarizes the investigated work and expresses the conclusions on the development of recommendations for evaluating the efficient operation of solar power plant.

articleTitle: The Influence of Different Types of Switching Sequences in Space-Vector PWM on Output Characteristics of Three-Level Voltage Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article studies the impact of various switching sequence types on the operation of a three-level neutral point clamped voltage source inverter during space-vector PWM. The authors reviewed three common sequences: standard, seven-stage, and five-stage. The sequences were compared using four criteria: the quality of the inverter output curve, the balance of the neutral point voltage, the common-mode voltage, and the mitigation of the switching losses. To assess the data for three of the sequences, the authors developed a computer model using Matlab & Simulink. The analysis of the results helps select the best switching sequence taking into account the operational requirements of the inverter, while the seven-stage sequence assures acceptable results for all four of the criteria used. The results provided in this article can be used for the design of electric drive systems that require high efficiency and reliability, as well as further research on three-level voltage inverters.

articleTitle: Estimating the Insertion Attenuation under Different Methods of Modal Redundancy in Differential and Common Modes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper investigates the dependence of the insertion attenuation in two configurations of the conductor arrangement before and after switching. The first configuration implies that the electrical characteristics of the structure used to provide modal redundancy are not the same. The second configuration implies that the electrical characteristics of this structure before and after switching are the same. The use of the first option allows taking into account and compensating for the predictable changes in the characteristics of radio-electronic equipment, as the radio elements degrade or age. Knowing the characteristics of conductor switching methods allows designers to determine where it is necessary to take into account the changing characteristics before and after switching, as well as to determine the most optimal switching in terms of noise attenuation in differential and common modes. For configuration #1, the insertion attenuation before switching was minus 14.8 dB in both modes, and after switching it was minus 11.8 dB and minus 13 dB in differential and common modes, respectively. For configuration #2, before and after switching, the insertion attenuation was minus 14.6 dB and minus 15 dB in differential and common modes, respectively.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of the Melt Pool Diameter on the Electrical and Thermal Parameters of an Induction Melting Furnace in a Cold Crucible with Bottom Heating
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The results of numerical study of furnaces of induction melting in a cold crucible with bottom heating (IMCC-BH) for vitrification of radioactive waste (RAW). The article discusses the influence of the diameter of the glass melt pool on the electrical and thermal parameters of the furnace. The influence of distance between cold crucible bottom and side wall was also studied. The research method is numerical modeling using a 2D electro hydrodynamic (EHD) and 3D electromagnetic (EM) finite element model of glass melting. As a result of the study, it was found that the use of IMCC-BH furnace with an increase in the diameter of the melt pool increases the thermal efficiency of the furnace. In this case, cooling of the peripheral zone of the melt pool is observed with sufficient heating of the melt in the melting zone. Sufficient influence of the distance between cold crucible bottom and side wall on IMCC-BH furnace electrical parameters was also found. The regularities obtained were used in the design of IMCC-BH furnaces for RAW vitrification.

articleTitle: Improvement of Diagnostic Devices for Loading Axle Boxes with the Help of Microprocessor Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Today, large-scale works are being carried out in the railway system to ensure traffic safety and increase operational reliability. Timely detection of faults in rolling stock and timely elimination of this fault will prevent technical and material losses in this area. As a result of these failures, it motivates the development of a rolling stock control and automatic diagnosis system. Traffic control system temperature control of the wheels during braking and in the bushing system, control of the overall dimensions of the wagons, control of wheel defects along the circumference, control of the geometric parameters of the wheels, control of the parameters of the impact mechanism, control of irregular loading of the cars, wheel creep control includes types of doing. If the devices with the above types of control are installed at the entrance to the station, between the stations (peregon) or before the maintenance points of the wagons, until the entry of the rolling stock, complete information about the content arrives. With this information, the correct troubleshooting of the rolling stock and the quality of maintenance are improved. One of the research objects is the system “Complex of technical means multiiunctional” (KTSM).

articleTitle: Assessment of Signal Delay in Digital Twins for Electromechanical and Hydraulic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: When making up the mechatronic complexes digital twins (DTs), one should take into account the time delay that occurs during the data exchange between the virtual model of a physical object and the algorithm of the control system being developed. The authors show the diagram of the virtual models configuration on a personal computer (PC) and in the resource of a programmable logic controller (PLC) are given. It is shown that when placing the control program in a PLC, and the DT model in a PC, an additional delay is introduced by the interface between the PLC and the PC. This leads to the distortion of information communication between the systems and disruption of the twinning process. Thus, the assessment of the signal delay in the digital twin structure is a relevant problem. The paper shows an example of the DT implementation in the Matlab Simulink Desktop Real-Time environment and presents a simulation of a conditional object with a proportional controller. The analysis of transients at the different gain coefficients of the controller is provided. It is shown that when the controller coefficients correspond to the optimal process without delays, the delay in signal transmission causes an increase in the system oscillatory properties. The article considers the determination of the delay time by estimating the time shift of the sawtooth signal entering the PLC input and its response after “returning” from the PC. To account for the delay, it is proposed to include additional modeling links in the system structure.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of Transformer Oil Condition by Its Chromaticity Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The main element of the electric power industry are power transformers, the bulk component of which is transformer oil. The aging of transformer oil leads to an increase in acid number and dielectric losses, to a change in the color of the oil and, as a result, to a decrease in the reliability of the entire insulation system of oil-filled equipment. The paper presents the results of a study of transformer oils with the determination of their chromaticity coordinates, and the relationship of chromaticity coordinates with the dielectric loss tangent and the acid number of the oil is also established.

articleTitle: Method for Calculating the Traction Electric Drive of a Vehicle with a Combined Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article presents the results of a study of the traction electric drive of a vehicle with a combined drive. The advantages and prospects for the use of capacitive energy storage devices of various types (electrostatic and electrolytic capacitors, capacitors with an electric double layer, (pseudocapacitors, hybrid capacitors) in various vehicle systems are shown. The analysis of the movement of the vehicle in the urban cycle is carried out. A mathematical model of the process of vehicle movement and a model of a capacitor bank in the MatLab Simulink environment were developed, which made it possible to determine the main parameters of the power elements of the vehicle's electric drive, such as storage and capacitor banks; traction synchronous three-phase electric motor with permanent magnets. A technical and economic evaluation of the effectiveness of the use of a capacitive energy storage device in comparison with a storage battery has been carried out. The application of the developed technique allows to improve the operational properties of both the onboard energy storage device and the wheeled vehicle as a whole.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of the Automatic Locomotive Signaling System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to solving an actual problem encountered in railway transport, namely, the demagnetization of rail lashes, which affect the operation of the automatic locomotive signaling system, ensuring the safety and timeliness of the arrival of trains. In the process of ensuring security in the world, special attention is paid to improving the methods and devices for eliminating failures in automation and telemechanics systems of railway transport. The practical significance lies in the development and creation of a wagon-platform, which produces demagnetization in the process of movement at a set speed using the proposed new method - pulse. Also presented is the wiring diagram for connecting the elements and equipment of the platform car of pulsed demagnetization. The developed programs for microcontrollers and the switching system make it possible to implement an algorithm for measuring the magnetic field induction. Microcontroller programs are written in a programming language, taking into account the technological process of railway transport.

articleTitle: Opportunities for Economic Efficiency Increase in Renewable Energy Powered Off-Grid Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In stand-alone renewable energy projects for remote communities, very approximate approaches to cost estimation are widely used. For example, logistics is estimated as a percentage of capital expenditures, similarly to inhabited areas. While for remote areas both the rate per kilometer and the distance in logistics are much bigger. The same applies to the assessment of construction and maintenance costs. The lack of data on renewable energy resources can lead to errors in the estimation of energy production in the first tens of percent, while capital and operating costs are often underestimated by multifold. Together with the frequent significant reassessment of energy input to the real energy system, this leads to the fact that projects do not achieve the planned economic indicators. In this paper, we compare the results of the feasibility study of the Verkhoyansk solar-diesel hybrid power plant obtained using a methodology for calculating an economically reasonable tariff and more advanced methods that take into account the specifics of the use of intermittent renewable energy. As a result, a significant difference is shown in both the optimal configurations of the power plant and levelized cost of electricity.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Identifying Lumped Parameters of Line Start Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Based on Measuring Only Electrical Quantities During Their Starting Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Line-start permanent magnet synchronous motors (LSPMSMs) are energy-efficient motors that can be an alternative to asynchronous motors in applications with direct powering from a three-phase network. However, LSPMSMs have difficulties with synchronization during start-up, the success of which depends on the torque and the moment of inertia of the loading mechanism. For this reason, it is advisable to investigate the process of LSPMSM launching by means of mathematical modeling using an ordinary differential equation model with lumped parameters. The parameters of this model can be obtained by identifying them in transient processes. This paper presents a novel identification method based on experimentally obtained data on instantaneous active and reactive powers during the LSPMSM start-up at no-load. Using the proposed method, parameters of a commercially available 0.55 kW, 1500 rpm LSPMSM were identified. A comparison of experimental and simulation waveforms calculated using the obtained parameters is presented.

articleTitle: Determination of the Required Number of Brake Shoes to Stop the Spontaneous Departure of Rolling Stock on Station Tracks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The spontaneous departure of rolling stock is an extremely dangerous case of a special accounting defect, which can lead to a train crash with serious consequences. The scientific article developed a mathematical solution for determining the number of required brake shoes to be installed at a stopping point depending on the physical parameters of the spontaneous departure wagons on the railway station tracks. U sing the developed expression, the process of determining the required number of shoes installed at the stop point depending on the speed of spontaneous departure wagons on the railway station tracks was modeled on the Windows Forms platform of the C # programming language of Visual Studio.

Author Keywords: load on the axle of the wagon
the potential energy of the wagon
the kinetic energy of the moving wagon

articleTitle: Multiple Modal Reservation in Flexible Printed Cables
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the ability of flexible printed cables (FPCs) with multiple modal reservation to attenuate ultra-short pulses in various case types of failures. We investigate three FPC structures with different arrangements of signal and reference conductors and their number. We consider two cases to simulate failures: short circuit (SC) and open circuit (OC) at the input. For FPCl, for the two failure cases, the maximum amplitude increases when switching to the upper right passive conductor and decreases when switching to the lower passive conductor (but only at SC-50). When switching to the lower left conductor, the attenuation is maximized and is 4 times half the e.m.f. at 2.8 times before failure. For FPC2, after switching to the upper left passive conductor, for the two failure cases, the maximum amplitude increases and is 0.374 V (at SC-50) and 0.343 V (at OC-50), whereas before failure it was 0.327 V. When switching to the lower left passive conductor, the attenuation is maximized and is 3.5 times with 3 times before failure. For FPC3, after switching to the left passive conductors, the maximum amplitude, after case types of failures, decreases and amounts to 0.336 V (when switching to the lower and at OC- 50) and 0.303 V (when switching to the upper and at SC-50), while before the failure it was 0.4 V. For FPC3, the maximum attenuation of 5 times is observed when switching to the lower right passive conductor at 3 times before failure.

articleTitle: Robust Stability Degree Maximization Cable Vertical Stabilization Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: We are examining a system that stabilizes a cable's verticality using interval parameters. We have developed a third-degree characteristic polynomial with interval coefficients to achieve optimal performance. The system's stability degree determines its speed, so our goal is to maximize its robust stability degree. We construct possible vertex critical root diagrams for a third-degree system to accomplish this. These diagrams display the critical poles of the system on a single vertical line. We then determine the inverse images of these poles among the characteristic polynomial coefficients polyhedron vertices. By maximizing the robust stability degree in the obtained test vertices of each critical root diagram, we can ensure the system's maximum performance.

articleTitle: The Modeling of PMSM During Dynamic Brake
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Emergency braking of robotic systems operating alongside humans (cobots) is an important element of their operation in terms of safety during production and convenience in working and interacting with humans. Timely execution of the stop command to the robot can help prevent equipment damage, avoid accidents in the workplace, and ensure the health and safety of personnel. In this regard, ensuring emergency stopping of the robot in the event of a contingency situation is one of the most crucial aspects of its operation. This study examines several methods for emergency braking of robotic systems and presents some simulation results of emergency braking for an electric drive of a cobot.

articleTitle: Calculation Method for Steady State in Open-Loop Power Lines with the Account of Thermal Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article represents a calculation method for steady state in open-loop power lines with voltage 6–110 kv with the account of temperature dependence of ohmic resistance. The authors conduct calculation of electrical and thermal conditions in power lines with the inner temperature offset. Stress calculation in nods is based on inverse matrix of nod and intrinsic conductivities, determined on the bases of LU/LUP decomposition. We consider insolation in this algorithm in four ways. The authors pay special attention to the way described in the corporate standard of the PJSC FGS UES. We conduct calculation for steady state on the example of test schemes IEEE 33 and 69 Bus with the account of temperature dependence of ohmic resistance. Results of simulation exercise, which prove efficiency of the calculating method, have been represented.

Author Keywords: a calculation method for steady conditions

articleTitle: Research of Electric Modes when Using Innovative Designs of Power Transformers in Power Supply Systems of Oil and Gas Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In modern conditions, power and power losses can be reduced by using the following innovative solutions in power transformer designs: using the effect of low - and high- temperature superconductivity, introducing new effective methods for forming the main magnetic flux using amorphous ferromagnetic materials, and using combined power transformer designs that combine the solutions listed above. In this work, the simulation of a section of the oil and gas field network with the replacement of existing oil transformers was performed in the RastrWin3 PC. The efficiency of using innovative transformers in comparison with oil-based ones was evaluated. Graphs of the dependence of the efficiency coefficient on the load factor (KZ) for various types of transformers were constructed. The results of modeling showed that the energy efficiency of innovative transformers is significantly higher than the energy efficiency of transformers with a traditional magnetic circuit design.

articleTitle: Electricity Production from Hydrocarbon Pyrolysis Products
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper discusses a version of a medium-temperature modular pyrolysis plant that can be used to derive all pyrolysis products - gas, oil, and carbon (soot) - from municipal solid waste (MSW). The yield of gas is 97·10-3, oil- 257·10-3, and carbon - 140.1·10-3 kg/(kg MSW). Specific heating value per kg MSW is 1,904 kJ for gas, 11,334 kJ for oil, and 4,680 kJ for carbon. The products of MSW pyrolysis have been used at an existing thermal power plant (TPP) equipped with the boiler E-120-100 and condensing turbine K-25-90. The rate of MSW consumption with the steam turbine unit operating at its maximum capacity of 25 MW is 5.35 kg MSW per second. Thermal efficiency of the unit is 26%. Specific MSW consumption for electric generation is 0.773 kg/kWh (0.474 kgoe/kWh). Electricity production per 1 metric ton (MT) of recycled MSW is 1,289 kW<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex>. The rate of MSW consumption to supply the diesel generator driving the drum of the pyrolysis plant with the capacity of 5.5 kW is 2.9 kg/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex>. Operation of the power plant at its full capacity of 25 MW would require 15 modular pyrolysis plants running simultaneously. A single pyrolysis unit and a low-power steam turbine (e.g., TG 0.75/6.3R13/2 KTZ) can be used for a mini-TPP with the capacity of 600 kW.

articleTitle: Test of Arc Fault Detection Devices for Operation from Spark Gaps and Arc Fault in an Electric Circuit of 0.4 kV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The most common cause of ignition of electrical equipment is arc flashover. Often this phenomenon entails great economic damage, human injury, and in some cases human death. There are several reasons why an arc fault may occur: a broken cable when it is bent at a turn, loosely pressed connectors, damage to the cable with a retainer, violation of the insulating layer, exposure and pinching of the wire, loose contact, damage by rodents, furniture. The insulation may be damaged due to high humidity in the room or prolonged exposure to ultraviolet radiation. To prevent breakdowns in the form of an arc fault detection devices, has been developed and successfully used, which, when a breakdown is detected, turns off the damaged circuit. International Standard IEC 62606:2013 “General requirements for arc fault detection devices” establishes the required list of test requirements for certification of arc fault detection devices. Testing requires equipment that provokes emergency situations, which ultimately leads to thermal arc flashover and fire in sections of a particular power system. The paper presents the developed device for checking the arc fault detection devices and tests for the conditions of operation for specific network parameters, the correctness of the arc fault detection devices operation is verified. The results obtained make it possible to judge the effectiveness of operation of various models of arc fault detection devices under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Construction of Signal Transmission Structures in Information Systems Based on Conjunction Schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The need to solve a wide class of problems for managing territory distributed objects in real time determines the need to ensure direct information interaction between control systems located at different, including non-adjacent, levels of the hierarchy. Functional reliability is a critical requirement for interacting information systems that operate in different environments and have different design and functional characteristics. The characteristics of the reliability of information interaction of information systems are critical factors of network-centric control. The need to manage the functional reliability of a set of heterogeneous information systems determines the need for a unified description of heterogeneous information flows between the components of the network-centric control information support system. This paper is devoted to the consideration of a unified approach to the formation of structural models of multidimensional information flows between different levels of a multilayer control system, based on the consideration of information interactions between heterogeneous information systems at the level of signal exchange.

articleTitle: Trends in the Development of Cargo Vehicles with Electric Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This study examines potential technical solutions for cargo vehicles with electric transmission, in particular, cargo transport of domestic development based on Ural cars and the peculiarities of their operation in cold climate conditions. The study examines the experience of various European and domestic manufacturers in the introduction of vehicles with a low cab. The study examines trends in the development of electric, hydrogen and hybrid vehicles, highlights European and domestic experience in this field. The work was carried out with the financial support of the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation as part of a comprehensive project aimed at creating a high-tech production of vehicles of the Arctic Bus family for safe transportation of passengers and mobile social facilities in the Far North.

articleTitle: Determination of the Saturation Time of Measuring Transformers in Transient Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The object of the paper is to determine the saturation time of the measuring transformer in transient processes. The article analyzes the results of calculating the saturation time of the current transformer, obtained by four different methods (analytical method, graphical method according to passport data, graphical method using CT voltammetric characteristic, graphical method using CT magnetization curve) using GOST 58669–2019 “Methodical guidelines for determining the time to saturation of current transformers during short circuits”, describes the method of modeling the current transformer. The methodology for determining the saturation time based on the straightened magnetization curve and the specified measurement error of the CT under study is given; the calculation results obtained using a computer model in the ATPDraw software package are analyzed, the results confirming the accuracy of the used computer model are shown. The digital model of CT described in the article can be used to verify the results obtained using GOST 58669–2019 and to make a final decision on the possibility of correct operation of CT and relay protection connected to its windings.

articleTitle: Application of a Mirror-Symmetric Modal Filter on a Double-Sided Printed Circuit Board for Multiple Modal Reservation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To increase the equipment functional safety of the equipment, redundancy is used. One promising method of redundancy is modal reservation (MR). In this paper, a new and easily implemented protection configuration with multiple MR is analyzed. A double-sided printed circuit board, in which two reference conductors are arranged symmetrically with respect to each other on the top and bottom dielectric layers between the signal conductors, is chosen as the object of study. Considered two cases to simulate failures: short circuit (SC) and open circuit (OC) at the input. The paper presents simulation results for 3 possible switching to reserve conductors: lower left; upper right and lower passive conductors. Thus, when switching to the lower right passive conductor, the attenuation is not significant, but becomes greater than before failure, and is 4.1 times the half e.m.f. In addition, a risk assessment of unipolar and multipolar decomposed pulses has been performed. N-norms were used to analyze the criticality of the decomposed pulses. The interference is shown to decompose into four pulses of lower amplitude. A significant attenuation is observed for all N-norms. This results demonstrate the high efficiency of interference protection in the new structure. It was also found that the probability of dielectric breakdown in reserving circuits is lower than in the reserved circuit.

articleTitle: Justification of Feasibility of Using Floating SPPs in the Kyrgyz Republic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The purpose of the study described in the article was to develop a methodology for optimizing the structure and parameters of the energy complex based on a modular floating solar power plant (SPP) with a capacity of 5 kW, working for an autonomous consumer, and to assess the feasibility of building floating SPPs on natural and artificial water bodies of the Kyrgyz Republic (KR). The feasibility of building such stations is substantiated on the example of power supply of the recreation center “Dead Lake”, located in the protected area on the coast of Lake Issyk- Kul in the KR. In the course of the study the above- mentioned methodology and the corresponding mathematical model realized in Microsoft Excel environment were developed. The latter was used to calculate the operating modes of the energy complex and assess its technical and economic efficiency. Special attention in the article is paid to the selected main and auxiliary equipment of the floating power plant and its electrical scheme.

articleTitle: About the Joint Use of Algorithms for Finding the Optimal Skeleton of an Electrical Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this article describes and suggests the use of an improved the reverse-delete algorithm for finding the optimal skeleton of an electrical network. A comparative analysis is performed with existing algorithms for finding the minimal spanning tree in the graph, and also algorithms for finding the shortest distance in the graph. Algorithms are compared from the point of view of asymptotic complexity and the ability to solve the problem. Together with the improved reverse-delete algorithm, it's recommended to use methods of numerical optimization, for example, the algorithm of particle swarm optimization. The joint use of algorithms will significantly reduce time for solving the problem of finding the optimal skeleton of an electrical network and will reduce technological losses in the distribution networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive Capabilities of Phase Vector Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Phase vector control of a brushless DC motor in the presence of a rotor angular position sensor is implemented in the simplest way. With phase vector control, the amplitude and phase of the motor supply voltage are regulated. There is no need to use coordinate transforms and measure phase currents. In a sensorless version of a phase vector control system, phase currents are used only to estimate an electromagnetic torque, rotational speed, and rotor angular position, which are necessary for organizing the vector control of the drive. Traditionally, to set phase vector control laws, a mathematical description of an electric machine is used, which is a steady-state lumped parameter model. In a real electromechanical converter, the processes are much more complicated, which is especially evident in heavily loaded electric drives operating under limit electromagnetic loads. This paper analyzes the adaptive capabilities of phase vector control systems, their operation capability under conditions of parametric disturbances and considerable uncertainty in a motor dynamic behavior. We studied the sensitivity of both sensor and sensorless versions of specific phase vector control systems to parameter variations, in particular, to changes in the inductive parameters of the winding and its active resistance. The simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: About Different Applications of Branches in the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In process of optimization algorithms based on swarm intelligence, a large count of intermediate «optimal» re-sults are obtained. Finally, optimization algorithm can give the optimal configuration of an electrical network, or close to opti-mal, but one way or another, the answer will be only one configu-ration. In power system, the network configuration can change for a number of reasons: fault, introduction of new technological equipment, operational switching, withdrawal of equipment for the repair. The purpose of this research is to search of application a large count of the configurations of distribution network obtained during in the operation of optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of the Improved EAF's Electric Circuit Mathematical Model for Application in Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: the article considers the structure of the indirect control loop of total conductivity in the electric mode control system of electric arc furnaces HIREG (Danieli, Italy). For the furnaces, where this system is operated, the overestimated value problem of standard deviations of currents and power at electric arcs, which leads to a suboptimal mode of operation and increased operating costs, is outlined. As a solution to this problem, it is proposed to use the digital twin concept to adapt the control loop setting to the current conditions of charge melting. The main idea of the proposed solution is that using a digital analogue of the electric furnace circuit with the HIREG control system, an iterative search for the most optimal regulator parameters is carried out, provided that its suboptimal operation is detected in accordance with a set of predetermined criteria. The research results are realised on the basis of one of the domestic furnaces. The technical effect was achieved in the reduction form of standard signals deviations of currents and power of electric arcs, which in turn provided value reduction of the operation under current time and specific power consumption.

articleTitle: Studying the Behavior of 2L Voltage Waveforms Based on Selective Harmonic Elimination PWM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, voltage source inverters (VSI) extensively use pulse-width modulation (PWM) methods with regular impulses within the reference carrier frequency. These methods include the sinusoidal PWM and the space-vector PWM. However, there is an alternative PWM method where individual impulses are not limited by the quantization period of the reference carrier signal and can change in width and position over the entire period of the VSI output voltage within the set symmetry. In research, this method is referred to as the Programmed Pulse Pattern PWM (PPWM). This article analyzes PPWM at selective harmonic elimination (SHE) technique for VSI two-level (2L) output voltage waveforms. SHE is one of the earliest and most widespread PPWM methods that aims at the gradual elimination of lower-order harmonics according to the set number of semiconductor module switchings. During this research, six SHE were calculated for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\mathrm{L}$</tex> voltage waveformss with quarter-wave symmetry starting from harmonic 5 and harmonic 7 (for three switchings) and to harmonic 35 and harmonic 37 (for thirteen switchings). PPWM sets were graphically represented as dependencies of switching angles for semiconductor VSI modules and the modulation factor. This article studied the spectra and factors of total harmonic distortions up to harmonic 50 of the voltage over the modulation factor change range from 0 to 1.15 at an increment of 0.01. The most significant results of the research include the dependencies between individual harmonic components and the modulation factor. The results of this research can be used in the development of PPWM methods with SHE for power converters with limited semiconductor module switching frequencies, solving the problems of their electromagnetic compatibility, improving energy efficiency, and optimizing power losses.

articleTitle: Problems Solving of Power Elements Uniform Loading and Energy Losses Reducing in a Multilevel Converter Based on a Universal Source of Levels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents study results of energy circulation and accumulation in the process of the output voltage curve forming in a single-phase multilevel inverter based on a universal two-channel source of levels, the power circuit structure of which does not depend on the number of levels. Objective of the study is developing of methods for active losses reducing in circuits for recharging of the pulse converters output capacitors, as well as in the process of reactive power exchange between the load and the source of levels. Measures to ensure uniform loading of the corresponding power semiconductor elements of the converter in the process of the output voltage curve forming are considered. It is shown that the reduction of energy losses is achieved by adding to circuits of pulse converters circuits for resetting of inductances excess currents to the power supply source of the multilevel inverter. It is proved that the decrease of the uneven loading of power semiconductor elements is achieved with the proposed asymmetric distribution of curve generated levels between pulse converters, as well as with an increase in the number of levels.

articleTitle: Intelligent System of Partial Discharge Diagnostics in Power Mains
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper is concerned with the system developed with the aid of artificial intelligence, which is capable of detecting partial discharges in overhead power line insulation. To improve fault detection accuracy, several stages of preprocessing are applied including division into frequency components, balancing, segmentation and normalization of data, which represent measuring of high-frequency parts of voltage band for each transmission line phase. It should be noted that electromagnetic waves within the frequency range of 10 and 20 MHz, which are formed at partial insulation failure, play the key role in partial discharge detection. For this purpose, the initial data are refined to separate high frequency and low frequency components. The accuracy of neural networks trained on the composite signal and its high frequency part differ by less than 1 %, while the accuracy of the network trained on the low frequency part is 17% lower. Real data were used to test the proposed system, thus confirming its applicability in practice. The developed intelligent system provides relatively high accuracy in diagnostics achieving about 88%. Thus, data mining shows that high frequency components prevail in partial discharge detection, that is, electromagnetic waves in the certain frequency band, which arise during partial insulation failure. This opens up new fields of use in developing new methods of partial discharge diagnostics on the basis of this band.

articleTitle: Method for Clarifying Trajectories of Multi-Link Manipulators Mounted on Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work describes the developed method for clarifying the trajectories of working tools (WT) of multi-link manipulators (MM) mounted on unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV) based on data obtained during recognition of a special graphic marker pre-fixed near the MM WT. The proposed method involves the use of technical vision systems (TVS) to identify the position of the MM WT and its subsequent comparison with the position calculated using the solution of the forward kinematics (FK) for this MM. These calculations are performed on the basis of information on generalized coordinates of MM obtained from sensors located in its degrees of freedom. Thus, by comparing the two spatial positions of the WT in real time, a correction vector is calculated that allows to clarifying the desired trajectory of the MM WT. The research of the developed method was carried out using numerical modeling in Matlab/Simulink and Unity, as well as full-scale experiments using MM and TVS developed in the IMTP of the Far Eastern Branch of the RAS. The results of the experiments confirmed the operability of the method and the high efficiency of its use. At the same time, an increase in the accuracy of WT movement on the surfaces of work objects during manipulation operations was confirmed.

articleTitle: Formation of a Russian-English Parallel Corpus for Automatic Translation of the Text of Patents
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of deep machine learning tools makes it possible, in the presence of a parallel bilingual corpus of text, to create your own translator in a separate subject area. The formation of an array of patents from the Patent Family (the same invention in Russian, English and other languages) makes it possible to create such a corpus for the training of an English- Russian translator. In the course of the work, an algorithm for the formation of a Russian-English parallel corpus for automatic translation of the text of patents was developed. In particular, algorithms have been developed: parsing patents with Google Patents; formation of a parallel corpus; teaching the model to translate patent texts using the seq2seq model. The developed algorithms are implemented as a software module in Python using Python, NLTK, spaCy, MySQL, ClickHouse. The software module has been tested on patents from the Google Patents website. To calculate the accuracy of the translation, the BLEU coefficient and the completeness coefficient were calculated.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Method for Monitoring High-Voltage Suspended Insulation Based on Electromagnetic Registration of Partial Discharge Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: the insulation of electrical equipment mainly determines the long-term and cost-effective operation of the electrical system. Therefore, the diagnosis of high-voltage dielectric elements is an urgent task for energy companies. The paper proposes a method for diagnosing dielectric elements based on the dynamic registration of electromagnetic radiation. The method involves the periodic measurement of a set of diagnostic parameters necessary for a reliable assessment of the operating state of high-voltage dielectric equipment and their comparison with reference values. The proposed method for diagnosing high-voltage dielectric elements has been tested in the diagnosis of high-voltage insulators. We have developed non-contact remote devices installed on each phase wire, measuring diagnostic parameters with subsequent computer processing of the accumulated information signals. The analysis of the set of necessary parameters allows us to draw a conclusion about the degree of operability of dielectric elements. A comprehensive monitoring system for high-voltage dielectric elements does not require the decommissioning of insulators. The processing of partial discharge signals ends with constructing the following characteristics: the amplitudes and the number of pulses in each phase interval and the distribution of the number of pulses over the amplitudes. The method allows one to control the technical condition of high-voltage dielectric elements without stopping the technological process of electric power transmission.

Author Keywords: methods of measuring the characteristics of partial discharges

articleTitle: Currents in Disconnected Overhead Transmission Line Grounded in Each Tower Lightning Wire, Induced by Magnetic Field Currents of Parallel Operating Overhead Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: All high and ultra-high voltage overhead transmission lines under construction or reconstruction are equipped by lightning wires with built-in optical communication channels. Such lightning wires are grounded in each tower, and that leads to induction in its longitudinal electromotive forces by overhead transmission line currents magnetic fields. Induced electromotive forces in lighting wire closed circuits create currents, which values must be determined and assessed in terms of heat losses, thermal resistance, contact voltage, etc. The paper discusses the methodology and algorithm for currents induced in lightning wire grounded in each tower by line phase currents magnetic fields determination.

Author Keywords: lightning wire with built-in optical communication channels

articleTitle: Development and Testing of an Algorithm for Determining the Angular Velocity of Rotation and Acceleration of a Synchronous Generator Rotor in Transient Processes Based on Phasor Measurement Units
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The study considers an algorithm for determining a synchronous generator rotor mechanical speed rotation according to the data of ph as or measurement unit. The mechanical speed of the rotor is a key indicator in the organization of the power unit operating mode emergency control. In addition, the mechanical speed of the synchronous generator rotor is used in testing the unloading speed of the turbine. Testing of the proposed method for determining of a synchronous generator rotor mechanical speed was performed on a physical model of a power system consisting of three low- power synchronous generators. As a result, the error in determining the the synchronous generator rotor mechanical speed did not exceed 0.5%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Servo Drive Dynamics with Allowance for Uncertainties by Methods of the Robust Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Automation of modern technological processes in most cases is carried out by means of an electric drive. Control objects such as industrial robots and manipulators, radar systems and antenna installations, CNC machines and rolling mills, extruders and paper machines often operate in conditions of uncertainty. The parameters of such objects can vary in a certain range according to unknown laws. Unstable parameters include the reduced moments of inertia of electric drives, active resistances and inductances of motors, and gains of amplifiers. External disturbances and noise of phase coordinate sensors also have a negative effect on control objects. The article is devoted to the analysis of the stability and quality of functioning of an electric drive with a brushless motor by methods of the robust control theory, taking into account the uncertainties of the mathematical model of the object and external disturbances. A PID controller is used as a corrective device for the investigated electric drive, the parameters of which are determined using the desired transfer function and the corresponding logarithmic frequency response. The paper obtained the time and frequency characteristics of the electric drive in a given range of unstable parameters. Based on the analysis of the characteristics obtained, conclusions are formulated about the stability and quality of the operation of an electric drive with classical sequential correction. Recommendations on the synthesis of electric drive controllers with uncertainties using the robust control theory of are given.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Parameters of the Control System of a Multi-Motor Asynchronous Electric Drive with Thyristor Voltage Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Based on the analysis of ways to solve the problems of coordinated rotation of electric motors in multi-motor systems, the expediency of using short-circuited asynchronous electric motors with thyristor voltage converters is shown. Functional and linearized structural schemes of a closed-speed TPN-AD system are considered, on the basis of which a block diagram of a multi-motor electric drive with three motors with a common speed controller in the Simulink - Matlab environment is developed. A system of differential equations in the form is compiled to solve the problem of parametric synthesis of the control system and calculation of speed and torque at the start of a three-motor electric drive. In a specially developed program in the algorithmic language Matlab, using a certain quadratic Lyapunov function, to minimize which, the scanning method was used, the parameters of the electric drive control system were obtained, realizing the given nature of the transient process during start-up. The results of the calculations showed the feasibility of the method for the synthesis of parameters of the control system of a multi-motor asynchronous electric drive with thyristor voltage converters

articleTitle: Investigation of the Design of an Induction Heating System for Quenching the Surface of Balls
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Hardening is widely used in the production of various parts, in particular balls for ball bearings. The processes of heat treatment of balls and induction heating installations construction for such processes require detailed study due to the mass production of bearings. Such operations are subject to the requirements of high profitability, accuracy of technology compliance and repeatability. Classical gas and electric heating technologies do not meet such requirements, so induction heating is gradually becoming more widely used in heat treatment. This article will present the results of the investigation an induction heating installation of a special design. This installation has an inductor in the form of a cylindrical spiral which partially covers the ball from two sides and rotates by a certain angle around the ball during its rolling on the inductor. The special shape of the inductor allows for improving the uniformity of heating of the ball surface. The research was carried out by the method of computational experiments based on a mathematical model built by means of the CedratFLUX program. This program designed to calculate fields of various physical nature, for example, electromagnetic and temperature distribution within some area. The fields are calculated using the finite element method. The research was carried out in order to determine the best design of an induction heating system, in particular the rational number of inductive conductors and their best location around the ball in order to ensure maximum efficiency and uniformity of heating the surface of the ball. The purpose of the presented article is to show possible options for modifying the proposed design of an induction installation and choose the most rational alternative for improve the energy characteristics of the inductor to ensure fast and uniform heating of the ball surface.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of The Sizes of Soft Magnetic Inserts of a Synchronous Machine with a Built-In Torque Transformer on the Electromagnetic Torque of the System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the topology of a direct-drive synchronous generator with an integrated torque transformer and associated magnetic systems. To enhance the efficiency of the synchronous generator's design, a study on the influence of the width of the magnetically soft inserts on the maximum electromagnetic torque will be conducted. The calculations were performed using the Comsol Multiphysics software, which is based on the finite element method. Based on the calculation results, it is concluded that the synchronous generator with associated magnetic systems achieves a higher electromagnetic torque with a segment width of 0.025 meters, and the generator's output power amounts to 174.42 kW.

articleTitle: Signature Analysis Algorithm in Parametric Systems of Leak Detection in Pipeline Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Trunk pipelines are the main transport type of hydrocarbons. Despite the extremely stringent requirements to their construction and operation, every year the accidents occur where the integrity of the pipeline structure is violated and leaks of the liquid transported occur. Thus, all pipelines are equipped with one or another leak detection system (LDS). In the most common parametric LDS, the reliability of leak detection depends not only on the accuracy of the measurement tools used to control the technological parameters, but also on the algorithms for processing the measurement information obtained. The article proposes an algorithm for analyzing signatures based on multiple-scale wavelet transformation of signal measurement and subsequent comparison of approximating coefficients with reference statistical data. The algorithm approbation through virtual experiments has confirmed its effectiveness for detecting both sudden and smooth leaks, including those occurring in small holes.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Primary Current Converter as Part of Devices Installed on the Wires of 6–10 Kv Overhead Power Lines for Electricity Metering and Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Improving the reliability of medium voltage distribution networks (6–10 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kV}$</tex> in Russia) remains a relevant task. One of the means of improving the reliability and observability of distribution zones is equipping them with innovative compact current and voltage sensors. Automated power control and metering station (APCMS) for 6–10 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kV}$</tex>, using a Rogowski coil with a split-core design as a current sensor, have been developed in collaboration between Ivanovo State Power Engineering University (ISPU) and an industrial partner. This paper presents the construction of the current sensor, as well as its new improved version using a ferromagnetic shield. The results of simulation in the Comsol Multiphysics software and error estimation of current conversion depending on the current conductor displacement are provided. Recommendations on the material for the sensor shield are given.

Author Keywords: automated power control and metering station

articleTitle: Simulation-Based Performance Evaluation of Wire-Grid approach for 3D Printed Antennas: Comparative Analysis and Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The advancements in 3D printing technology have revolutionized the design and fabrication of complex antennas, enabling the development of smaller and lighter designs. However, these changes in physical dimensions necessitate a thorough investigation of the antenna characteristics before large-scale production. Simulation plays a crucial role in the evaluating these characteristics. This research paper focuses on verifying the wire-grid approach for modeling perforated antennas. A perforated horn antenna was modeled using two different wire-grid structures, and the results were compared with those obtained using another software. Additionally, the simulation results were compared with measurements taken from various types of 3D printed antennas. The comparative analysis demonstrates a high level of consistency and highlights the effectiveness of the wire-grid approach in simulating antenna behavior. These findings emphasize the possibility of using wire-grid approach together with the 3D printing technology to evaluate and optimize complex antenna structures. By harnessing the potential of 3D printing technology and simulation tools, researchers and engineers can continue to push the boundaries of antenna design and fabrication, leading to the development of smaller, lighter, and more efficient antennas for a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Detection of Defects in Welded Butt Joints Based on Laser Scanning: Neural Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work is devoted to the detecting of defects in welded butt joints based on the data from the computer vision system (iRVision 3DL) installed on a Fanuc welding robot. The main approach to solving the problem is deep learning of artificial neural networks. The images of the welded joint were obtained as a result of laser scanning. The obtained images of scanned surfaces were represented in a vector form of boundary points' values. The neural network is based on one-dimensional convolutional layers, which are good for searching patterns in the data. The task of the research was to obtain a neural network model with the maximum potential value of the metric because the missing defects are unacceptable in manufacturing and always have a bad influence on the properties of welded steel structures. The results indicate the applicability of this approach to the problem of defect detection in welded joints.

articleTitle: Identification of Quasi-Global Extrema in the Calculation of Induction Motor Double-Loop Equivalent Circuit Parameters Using Numerical Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Boundary effects of the method for calculating the parameters of a double-loop equivalent circuit (EQC) of a deep-bar induction motor with a squirrel-cage rotor, based on the numerical solution of a system of nonlinear algebraic equations and underlying its synthesis in MathWorks® MATLAB® software package, are considered. The case of calculating the EQC of a high-voltage induction motor with a quasi-global residuals minimum with an unacceptably large rotor circuits time constants ratio of 2836 as well as stator current locus that does not correspond to the principles of constructing induction machines is considered. A comparison of the equivalent circuit synthesized using numerical and analytical methods via calculation of the induction motor direct start-up using differential equations was carried out. Recommendations for identifying inadequate EQCs with the help of stator current loci and replacing them with parameters obtained analytically are given.

Author Keywords: numerical and analytical methods of parameters calculation

articleTitle: The Use of Dynamic Characteristics in Handwriting Recognition Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the presented paper different approaches are investigated to recognize handwritten characters represented as points of the pen trajectory. In doing so, datasets in different languages are investigated. In addition, a method for extracting dynamic characteristics from a data set of handwritten characters is described. The peculiarity of the method is that the analysis of motion focuses on the oscillatory component of the writer's hand motion. After preprocessing the trajectory data, a very compact vector of features characterizing the symbol is obtained, which leads to a significant reduction in the amount of resources and time required for processing. The proposed method can significantly improve the accuracy of optical recognition of handwritten characters. Also, the extracted information can be used in other fields related to character recognition, such as analysis of glyphs or signatures, as well as analysis or transfer of writing style.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection Based on Weakly Supervised Learning and Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a method for detecting defects based on a convolutional network on graphs and weakly controlled learning. The defect detection algorithm includes the following steps: preliminary segmentation of the image into regions using simple linear iterative clustering method, construction of the region adjacency graph, prediction of graph nodes based on graph convolutional network on graphs. The region adjacency graph is being constructed. Each region is a node of the graph. The edges of the graph connect adjacent regions of the image. Spectral convolution of graphs is used in the proposed approach. Defects are marked on the training dataset using circles and ovals. The metric mean absolute error was used to evaluate the developed method. The method has good results when using inaccurate labeling. The structural description of the scene makes it possible to compensate for the accuracy of the annotated data to some extent.

articleTitle: Transforming Agribusiness in Algeria: Harnessing Cognitive Visual Environment and Data-Driven Technologies for Sustainable Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Algeria's agricultural output has been greatly influenced by the unfavorable effects of climate change in Africa. The main developments and adoption prospects for agricultural technology are examined in this article, with an emphasis on their intellectualization, digitization, and Big Data integration. Furthermore, it presents the idea of the cognitive visual environment as a potentially effective way to improve smart agriculture practices in Algeria. In order to maximize agribusiness operations, the study investigates the possibilities of the cognitive visual environment by utilizing cutting-edge technology, data analytics, and intelligent systems. This study uses Python to examine unemployment data for Algeria from 1991 to 2021, processing and analyzing the data using Hadoop and PySpark. The goal of the study is to pinpoint temporal trends in the unemployment rate as well as the variables that contribute to the persistently high rate of unemployment. The results show that despite fluctuations, the unemployment rate was continuously high. Low private sector job growth, a lack of economic diversity, and a skills gap are all factors that contribute to high unemployment. For decision-makers and professionals attempting to address Algeria's unemployment, these insights are helpful. This study adds to the expanding body of literature on using Hadoop and big data for economic analysis, emphasizing the value of using cutting-edge analytical tools for well-informed decision-making.

articleTitle: Methodology for the Development of Internal Power Supply Systems for Buildings and Constructions in the Revit Modeling Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Conservative methods of developing projects for internal power supply systems of buildings and constructions of various functional purposes, to which various CAD systems can already be safely attributed, have been proven to be an effective tool for processes automation of creating and issuing project documentation, but not properly linked between various sections of technical solutions. Due to such a significant lack and the emergence of innovative technologies for creating digital models of buildings and constructions, the problem of developing an approach to the formation of projects for various engineering systems in the BIM environment (Building Information Model or Modeling) becomes relevant. This environment, previously used to develop predominantly architectural and constructive solutions, now allows creating digital twins of various elements for technical systems in the volume necessary for construction and operation. Due to the fact that these elements are equally detailed both geometrically and parametrically (the object is not a conditional geometric primitive, but is endowed with all the necessary physical properties appropriate to a real element), it is possible to form a full-fledged digital model of the engineering system for a building or construction by actions aimed at creating relationships between digital elements according to a certain principle. The most popular software for developing design solutions within the framework of BIM technologies is currently Revit software from Autodesk, which is the developer of the world's most popular CAD solution -AutoCad. The main principles of the methodology for the development of internal power supply systems for buildings and constructions in the Revit modeling information environment are formulated in this paper.

articleTitle: Selection of Parameters of Insulation of Polymer-Gas Insulated Transmission Line for Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The research dwells upon the development and substantiating the use of new polymer-gas insulation for insulated transmission line. The insulated transmission line under consideration is designed for laying in seawater and transmitting electrical energy from wind turbines. To improve the electrical strength and reduce the dimensions of the conducting wire, a new polymer coating for current-conducting elements has been developed where gas insulation is used as the main one to reduce electricity losses. The authors provide technical solutions for the execution of various sections of the insulated transmission line with polymer-gas insulation. The authors analyze the distribution of the electric field strength in combined insulation further comparing the results with the distribution in homogeneous solid insulation. The physical parameters of the solid insulation used in the insulated transmission line were experimentally defined. The application of polymer-gas insulation in the insulated transmission line showed its capability of reducing dielectric losses in the transmission line by at least 2-2.5 times.

articleTitle: Analysis of Existing Methods for Leakage Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Contamination accumulation on the insulator surface is the reason for overhead transmission lines (OHTL) accidents. The contamination accumulates and washes during operation depending on climatic and other factors. A leakage current (LC) is one of the parameters of the insulator state which correlate with contamination severity and can be measured and compared to decide on the replacement or cleaning of the insulator. The LC dramatically depends on external factors, and it differs in different stages of the flashover process. This paper highlights the methods of analysis for forecasting the LC as correlating factor with the insulator condition.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Comparing Models for Calculating the Magnetic Field Strength of a Solenoid in Magnetostrictive Linear Displacement Transducers on Surface Waves Used in Automated Technical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
