abstract: Article is devoted to research and calculations of magnetic fields and fluxes, as well as output signals in primary converters of magnetostrictive sensors of linear displacements on longitudinal waves used in automated technical systems. The dependences of projection on 0Z axis of magnetic field strength formed by solenoid on z coordinate measured from its center have been studied. It is noted that in magnetostrictive displacement transducers on longitudinal waves, it is possible to use two solenoids designed to form input and output signals, respectively. For research, two models were used to calculate projection of magnetic field strength of solenoid on 0Z axis - simplified and for accurate calculation. For considered calculation models, computational experiments were carried out to determine change in value of projections on 0Z and 0r axis of magnetic field strength created by solenoid relative to its center for two considered calculation models. The results obtained and mathematical calculation models under study were also used for expressions and computational experiments to determine dependence of magnetic flux and output signal on z coordinate measured from center of solenoid. The results of computational experiments for solenoids with same parameters, properties and linear dimensions showed a complete coincidence in calculating longitudinal component (along 0Z axis) and discrepancies in values between models under consideration exceeding 20% for axial component, which allows us to draw conclusions about possibility of practical use for calculating longitudinal component in automated technical systems of each of models under consideration and an accurate model for calculating axial component.

articleTitle: The System of Coordinated Semi-Automatic Remote Control by Two Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper discusses a method that ensures the coordinated operation of two mobile robots, one of which is equipped with a multi-link manipulator and a vision system, and the second - auxiliary - only a vision system. At the same time, the task of remote control of the manipulator of the main mobile robot performing operations in the cramped conditions of the working area, when the objects of work are out of sight of its vision system, is solved. In this situation, the vision system of an auxiliary and more maneuverable mobile robot is used to monitor the objects of work when performing various operations with them. In addition, this vision system is able to change the spatial orientation by rotating about two mutually perpendicular axes. The mathematical apparatus proposed in the paper allows to take into account the different current spatial orientation of the base platforms of both mobile robots at the angles of roll, pitch and yaw in the absolute coordinate system. The results of the simulation confirmed the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study of the Performance of Electrical Equipment of Electric Power Complexes and Systems Under the Influence of Higher Harmonics of Voltage and Current
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this article the main aspects related to the influence of higher harmonics on the work of electrical equipment are considered. The relevance of this study is determined by the fact that at present in electrical systems and networks it is very difficult to maintain a proper level of electricity quality. This is due to the widespread introduction of semiconductor control systems, which are non-linear load and source of high harmonics of current and voltage. A big problem in electrical networks containing high harmonic sources is reactive power compensation with capacitor batteries. The connection of capacitor batteries together with the valve transducers was found to cause resonance phenomena in these networks. In this case, normal operation of capacitor units is not possible without special measures aimed at eliminating capacitor overload. The invention makes it possible to use a circuit for connecting protective filter reactors to work in parallel with capacitor batteries. Also, in order to identify the problems associated with higher harmonics in low-voltage we made measurements of harmonic components of voltage of municipal electrical receivers of apartment buildings. As a result of the connection of the quality analyzer on the input panel of the apartment building, a schedule of three-day measurement of the non-linear voltage distortion coefficient of the network was obtained. Sinusoidal voltage distortion coefficient increased to 7.4% during the maximum evening electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Influence of Distribution Network Concentrated Inhomogeneities on Traveling Wave Propagation Speed
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents the influence of concentrated inhomogeneities of the distribution network on traveling wave (TW) propagation speed and transient signal's (TS) duration. A simulation model of a simple overhead single-wire transmission line 10 km long with an ideal voltage source of 10 kV is used. The concentrated inhomogeneity was represented in the form of capacitance and a branch, at the end of which the idle mode and capacitive load were formed. The results of propagation modeling of voltage spike's TW at different time scales are presented. TS shaping in different points of the electric network of one and the same switching event is shown.

articleTitle: Improving the Electromagnetic Compatibility of Hot Rolling Mill Electric Drives at CJSC “MMK Metalurji” with Supply Network 34.5 $\text{kV}$
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For more than a decade, the electric drives based on frequency converters with active front end FC-AFE and AC motors with voltages of 3 - 3.45 kV have been considered the most efficient among regulated electric drives of high power, from the point of view of reliability and economy. These drives are widely used in various industrial areas, where they are mainly used in units with frequent dynamic modes. In particular, in metallurgy FC-AFE are used as part of the main electric drives of rolling mills. The experience of industrial operation shows that when FC-AFEs operate in 6–35 kV in-plant distribution networks, unacceptable voltage distortions may occur due to the network configuration and PWM features of FC-AFEs. Such problems are present in the 34.5 kV distribution network of CJSC “MMK Metalurji” steel plant, where FC-AFEs are used as main electric drives of hot rolling mill. This paper is devoted to finding solutions to ensure electromagnetic compatibility of these FC-AFEs with the 34.5 kV supply network.

articleTitle: Output Voltage Model of the Automotive Alternator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The automotive alternator is a key component of the power supply system providing power to consumers of the on-board electric system and battery charge. The evaluation of the alternator technical condition is possible based on comparing the current output voltage with the voltage of an alternator in good order. To do this, one needs to know how the output voltage of an efficient alternator changes at the varied speed and load modes. The alternator EMF depends on the rotor rotation frequency and the magnitude of the magnetic flux, for which a polynomial model of the third degree is proposed. The load connection brings about the occurrence of the alternator voltage which is less than the EMF due to the voltage drop at the active (ohmic) and inductive resistances of the stator winding. The inductive resistance of the stator winding is obtained from the data of the idling and short circuit experiments and is approximated by a linear model. To verify the accuracy of the developed analytical expressions, a mixed load cycle is proposed, during which the rotor rotation frequency, the excitation winding current and the alternator current change simultaneously. The developed model of the output voltage of the automotive alternator has confirmed its operability with the account of the operational limitations of the input parameters.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Efficiency of a Non-Isolated Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes an experimental study of the efficiency of a non-isolated bridge converter. To determine the losses during the operation of bridge converters, non-isolated converters are often used, which can be used to judge switching losses. Formulas for calculating switching losses are given. The experimental setup is described, the work waveforms and photographs are given. The experiments were carried out at different switching frequencies (100 Hz, 1 kHz, 2 kHz,5 kHz and 10 kHz) and input voltages (10 V, 25 V, 50 V, 100 V and 150 V). Based on the data, the efficiency and the relative voltage drop are calculated. Graphical dependences between the efficiency of the converter on the input voltage and switching frequency are constructed. Recommendations for improving the efficiency and reliability of the converter are given.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar Gas Turbine Plant for the Conditions of Australia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article explores the potential of hybrid solar gas turbines as a sustainable energy solution tailored to the unique environmental conditions of Australia. By combining the efficiency of gas turbines with the abundant solar resources found in the region, these systems hold promise for enhancing energy generation while reducing emissions. The principles behind hybrid solar gas turbines and their advantages, including increased efficiency and reduced environmental impact, are discussed. Expanding on this background, a hybridized model of a gas turbine coupled with concentrated solar technology is proposed, specifically designed to suit Australia's unique climatic and geographical conditions. The model is developed and simulated using “Thermoflex” software, taking into account the specific parameters and constraints relevant to Australia. This proposed hybrid model showcases the potential for leveraging solar thermal energy alongside a gas turbine to achieve enhanced efficiency and a more sustainable power generation system. The findings of this study can contribute valuable insights for the advancement of hybrid solar gas turbine plants in Australia and demonstrate their viability in meeting the country's energy needs while reducing CO2 emissions.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Composition of the Solar-Diesel Unit in the Autonomous Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The aim of this work is the development of methods for optimizing the structure of the autonomous energy complex, which consists of photovoltaic conversion, diesel generators and battery packs and its implementation in a software package. Optimisation of the complex structure has been implemented through the particle swarm method, objective function of which is the final cost of energy produced. When optimising, load schedule of end users was taken into account, as well as actinometric and meteorological conditions of the area, technical characteristics of the photovoltaic panels and battery packs. There are also three PV panels install options relative to the horizon: horizontally; at an angle to the horizon; at an angle to the horizon with single axis base with a vertical axis of rotation, using the sun tracking system (tilt angle needs to be equal to the latitude). For isolated consumers of Tuva Republic, which function from diesel power plant, the total estimated power of electric generating elements of autonomous energy complex, optimised with the particle swarm method, is 3 578 kW with the capacity of battery packs equal to 1 751 kW<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex>. The developed method of energy complex optimisationis implemented in the software environment MATLAB. After optimisation by the proposed method of structure of the autonomous energy complex with inclined arrangement of PV panels, estimated net cost of produced energy is 16 rubles/kW<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex> with capital expenditure being 374 million rubles. The use of this optimised complex structure can lead to decrease of diesel fuel consumption to 60 %.

articleTitle: Ranking of Countermeasures Against Cyberattacks in Cyberphysical Systems of Critical Infrastructure Facilities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The relevance of cybersecurity to critical infrastructure, such as nuclear facilities, cannot be overstated. A distinctive feature of cybersecurity at nuclear facilities is the severe consequences of its violation, and the consequences of cyber-attacks can have catastrophic consequences and even reach national proportions. A study of the field of cybersecurity of nuclear power facilities has shown that the problem of ensuring the security of such facilities has not been fully solved. To solve this problem, we have developed models and algorithms for creating attack vectors for cyber-physical systems of critical infrastructure facilities. The models and algorithms were developed considering the specifics of a particular object and statistical data, distinguishing them from previously proposed vectors of attacks on cyber-physical systems. Generated vectors allow one to analyze possible security impacts and rank countermeasures to these vectors. The countermeasure ranking method uses lists of attack vectors and open vulnerability databases, which makes it possible to rank countermeasures according to various criteria. Such approaches have not previously been used in the specifics of the objects under study.

articleTitle: Simulation of Air Cooler Operation under Changing Performance of Booster Compressor Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Gas cooling after compression is one of the main technological operations in the process of its preparation for long-distance transport. Cooling occurs inside special air coolers (AC) due to heat exchange between the gas flow passing inside the finned tubes and atmospheric air blowing through the tubes from the outside by means of fans. One of the issues in the AC operation is the uneven distribution of the temperature field in individual sections and the resulting formation of hydrates in some areas. To prevent this undesirable and dangerous phenomenon, various methods are used, including disconnecting a certain number of fan sections. AC control systems are based mainly on mathematical models, because it is difficult to obtain all the necessary information instrumentally. The article proposes a model that allows controlling the AC operation under the changing performance of a booster compressor station by forming a preventing regulatory effect. This smooths out sharp temperature jumps and prevents overcooling of individual sections of the AC parts thus preventing hydrate formation.

articleTitle: Development of New Values of Specific Design Electrical Loads of Multi-Apartment Residential Buildings on the Example of Moscow
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of the national standardization program consists in carrying out work to update and create a regulatory technical base in the field of optimizing design and electrical work in civil engineering. One of the priority modern tasks in the civil engineering of the Russian Federation is to reduce the cost of building power supply systems. One of the options for solving this problem is the method proposed by the authors, which consists in developing new specific design electrical loads that will take into account the current state of electrical energy consumption, contributing to a decrease in the number and power of power transformers simultaneously with a decrease in the cross section and total length of cable and wire products. The article presents the results of a study of the electrical loads of multi-apartment residential buildings in Moscow for the period from April 2021 to February 2023, which served as the basis for the development of amendments to the Federal Code of Regulations SP 256.1325800.2016 “Electrical Installations in Residential and Public Buildings. Design and Installation Rules”. The new specific design electrical loads turned out to be lower than the normative ones by an average of 40%. To take into account the trend in housing construction, aimed at increasing the number of apartments in a multi-apartment residential building (the number of apartments reaches 2000 or more), new values of specific design electrical loads have been developed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Load Distribution in the Power System by the Method of Lagrange Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The main requirements for the power supply system of industrial facilities are: reliability, good power quality, safety and efficiency of all system elements. In this article the generalized model of research object is considered, the calculation of power system parameters at the existing mode of operation and mathematical modeling of power consumption mode of outgoing line at concentrated load at the end of line are made, the calculation of extremums of Lagrange function, technical devices for optimization of power system operation mode are proposed and the technical and economic calculation of efficiency of proposed variant of power system optimization is made.

articleTitle: Results of Arc Processes Registration in Single-Phase Short Circuits of Low-Voltage Power Grids with an Isolated Neutral
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Electrical networks with isolated neutral at low voltage (IT systems) have become very widespread. Their main property is the possibility of long-term operation in the single-phase circuit mode. However, in many cases, single-phase insulation damage is accompanied by arc processes that make the short circuits of the type especially dangerous. The characteristics of the grounding arc determine if a single-phase short circuit can transition to a short circuit and if vapor- and gas-air mixtures in the environment of an arc circuit occur can ignite or explode. The paper presents the results of studies into the arc processes when the single-phase damage to rubber-insulated cables occurs. It provides an experimental evaluation of the arc discharges parameters, including the heat release rate at the short circuit point, maximum arc current surges and arc resistance.

articleTitle: The use of Microprocessor Devices for Automatic Control of the Excitation of Factory Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the main trends in modern energy today is an increase in the number of small-scale industrial facilities. This complicates the possible modes of operation of the power supply system. The operation of heterogeneous sources is carried out jointly with a power system of greater power, which determines their weak influence on the voltage level at the connection point. It is possible that the power plant will switch to an island mode of operation with a load. At the same time, the requirements for excitation systems become much more complicated. In particular, the presence of stabilization channels requires additional complex calculations that make it possible to indirectly determine the mode parameters necessary for operation in accordance with the selected excitation control law. When using group control of excitation of synchronous generators, it becomes necessary to process and store a large amount of data. Parallel operation of factory generators with a high power system also significantly complicates the laws of excitation control. The article deals with cases of implementation of automatic excitation control, requiring the use of additional microprocessor devices or controllers. A law of excitation control has been developed, adapted to the conditions of factory power supply when working together with the power system. A system has been developed for automatic control of excitation of a factory generator for normal operation, which requires the use of microprocessor devices. The necessity of using microprocessor means is substantiated by the example of the developed principle of excitation control in normal operation.

articleTitle: Detection of Defects in Welded Joints Based on Data from the Computer Vision System Using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers a transfer learning approach for solving the problem of defect detection in welded joints. The dataset was based on the 3DL images of the welded joints made by the computer vision system (iRVision). The dataset was labeled in different ways so as to find the optimal labeling method for such specific datasets. A pre-trained neural network with YOLOv5 topology was used as the primary tool to solve the problem, which has proven itself as a high-quality and fast single-pass detector widely used in the task of detecting objects in the images. A comparative analysis of different YOLOv5 topologies as applied to different welding defect marking methods was performed as part of the study. The obtained results indicate the applicability of such an approach to the task of welding defects detection using the computer vision system (iRVision).

articleTitle: TUAV Location Algorithm Based on SINS Data and Airborne Radar Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For effective use of tethered unmanned aerial vehicles (TUAVs), on-board controls are required to stabilize their position in space. For extended autonomy, SINS (Strap down Inertial Navigation System) data on the TUAV's spatial position must be corrected by “tech-vision” systems. Except at night and in poor visibility conditions, the 4-meter optical-electronic (OE) and infrared (IR) sensor suites used in the vertical takeoff and landing UAV significantly limit the TUAV's operating time at altitudes up to 300 meters. The proposed replacement of the OE/IR sensor data with data from a MIMO-based on-board radar on the position of a radio-contrasting object (reference point) not only eliminates time constraints on the TUAV's operation, but also significantly reduces computational costs, since the radar data is in binary form. The evaluation of the accuracy of the TUAV position data obtained on the basis of the developed algorithm for the specific case of 100 m cable length and 5 degree angular error showed that the largest errors (up to 8 m) in the determination of the TUAV orientation were observed in the horizontal plane for all considered sensor types. Vertically, the largest errors (3 m) occur when SINS angles are inaccurate. Radar generated data can cause errors of approximately 1.2 m vertically.

articleTitle: Overall Currents Unbalance Assessment for Several Three-Phase Loads under Sinusoidal Conditions of Four-Wire Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper deals with complex-valued negative and zero sequences current unbalance factors, which in addition to the magnitudes ratios also take into account the phase differences between the negative and positive sequences' currents and between the zero and positive sequences' currents. These coefficients allow uniquely locate any currents asymmetry modes. The equations for calculating the general complex negative sequence current unbalance factor and zero sequence current unbalance factor according to the known similar coefficients for each separate three-phase load of a four-wire circuit under sinusoidal voltages and currents conditions are presented. Also the equations for the desired phase currents to be drawn from the power network by a balancing device (in particular a passive or/and active filter or some other type compensator) to eliminate both the negative and zero currents components are offered. Thus, the approach makes it possible to assess the overall current asymmetry and the necessary measures to eliminate it even before connecting three-phase loads, without directly metering the total circuit currents values. An example of calculating the above complex current unbalance factors, based on metering in a PSIM model magnitudes and initial phase angles of currents, is considered. The compensated mode is also demonstrated via using AC current sources of the PSIM model.

articleTitle: Cyber Resilience Metrics Assessment of Cyber- Physical Energy System Information Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The process of development of electric power systems (EPS), due to the widespread adoption of new intelligent technologies and its digital transformation, has led to the creation of cyber-physical energy system (CPES) that are characterized by the close interrelationship of information-communication and physical subsystems. In this regard, there is a tendency for the resilience of CPES to deteriorate due to failures and malfunctions of the information infrastructure objects, including as a result of cyber attacks. This should be taken into account when assessing the reliability and resilience of CPES, so the issues of ensuring cyber resilience of objects of information infrastructure become relevant. The article analyzes the possible causes of cyber resilience disruptions in CPES information infrastructure. We propose a information infrastructure object cyber resilience model, on the basis of which we develop an algorithm for determining the values of cyber resilience metrics of information infrastructure object, taking into account the quality of information used in the management of CPES.

articleTitle: Determination of Initial Conditions for Topological Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The design of electrical machines, and in particular, synchronous motors, is actively developing in different directions. And a promising solution is to use a tool that has already proven its effectiveness in other industries, topological optimization. However, when starting to work with this tool, the designer faces a lot of difficulties, some of which will be discussed in this article. Based on familiarization with the results of literary sources of other authors in this subject, the following problems were identified and considered when working with topological optimization: local extrema, long optimization execution time, and the required number of input parameters. Their influence on the design process is determined and possible solutions are proposed.

articleTitle: A Power Supply System for an Industrial Facility with a Synchronous Electric Drive as a Reactive Power Factor Control Object
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article reviews a power supply system (PSS) of an industrial facility that has medium- and low-voltage transformer substations (35 and 6 kV) controlled by 6 kV and 0.4 kV adjustable capacitor units. The substations are connected to high-power asynchronous motors (AM) of various voltage classes, as well as 6 kV synchronous motors (SM). To synthesize an automated control system (ACS), the authors produced a mathematical model of the facility PSS based on the mathematical models of the synchronous motor and the transformer as the reactive power (RP) factor control object. The control voltage of the high-power (HP) automated excitation control (AEC) of the synchronous motor was used as the control input, the RP factor of the PSS was used as the output coordinate, and the changing of the active and reactive power during the startup and operation of asynchronous motors was used as the perturbation factor. The authors obtained transient process graphs and logarithmic frequency characteristics of the PSS as the reactive power factor (RPF) value control object that helps evaluate the stability of the facility PSS. This article aims to develop a PSS RPF ACS that will help facilitate the limiting RPF values, reduce the losses during the electric power (EP) transmission to the consumers, increase the carrying capacity of power lines, and improve the stability of PSS in the dynamic mode.

articleTitle: A Single-Phase Brushless 4 Slots-4 Poles Flux Switching Generator with Modular Rotor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Single-phase generators are applicable in the field of small and medium power to supply power for electrical networks of autonomous objects and private households. Small wind turbines with single-phase generators feeding the inverter's DC link have become widespread. Such systems are simple and quite reliable. However, a change in wind strength over a wide range leads to fluctuations not only in frequency, but also in the voltage level. This may be undesirable for sufficiently powerful installations of 5 kW or more, as it leads to fluctuations in the DC level at the inverter's input. It is also desirable to have regulation of the excitation flow when the load is powered directly from the output - for example, portable generators used in autonomous farms. This article proposes a simple and reliable 4 slots-4 poles design of a single-phase generator with a modular rotor. The difference from already known prototypes is the number of rotor poles and stator slots, as well as their geometric dimensions. This design is suitable for most types of loads and applications, as well as for powering the inverter's DC input for small wind turbines.

articleTitle: Solving the Classification Problem for Setting the Relay Protection Response Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of determining the response characteristics of relay protection is considered as a one-class classification problem. To solve it, an auxiliary class is introduced, as a result the problem becomes solvable as a two-class classification problem for the monitored and alternative modes. The response characteristics are constructed by training a linear classifier, so the resulting characteristics are parametric. At the same time, restrictions are imposed on the learning process of the classifier, related to the fulfillment of the requirements of selectivity and maximum sensitivity of protection. By the example of building the response characteristics of the long-range protection (LRP), three cases of using the auxiliary class are considered.

articleTitle: Two and Three-Dimensional Physical Fields of Electrical Machines High-Performance Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The author deals with the challenge of evaluating the effectiveness as far as the application of the numerical- analytical method of standard elements in three-dimensional field calculations of electrical devices is concerned. The main features of the standard element method are described, which makes it possible to perform a high-performance calculation of the field in such systems. A formalized procedure for replacing the area of electrical devices with standard elements with known analytical solutions of boundary value problems is presented. The three- dimensional magnetic field of a magnetic system with permanent magnets has been calculated by means of the finite element and the standard element methods. The form of the functional corresponding to the boundary value problem is given as the sum of integrals over surfaces introduced into the computational domain of standard elements in the form of parallelepipeds. It is shown that the use of the method of standard elements allows providing high-performance calculations of the field distribution due to a radical reduction in the degree of sampling in the framework of computational domain, minimization of the amount of calculations, and the use of well-known analytical boundary solutions in standard elements. Comparative estimates of the accuracy and efficiency of the standard element method as related to the finite element method have been obtained. The perspectives of applying as well as the high performance of the method of standard elements in the calculations of the physical fields of electrical devices have been proved.

articleTitle: Using a Real-Time Operating System to Effectively Control of Power Electronics Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper presents the use of a real-time operating system (RTOS) for developing software for control systems of power electronics devices. One of the advantages of using a RTOS for power electronics software development is the ability to solve multiple tasks with different priorities and terms. A RTOS can also offer features such as inter-task communication, synchronization and resource management. In this paper we described how a RTOS can be applied to control systems of power electronics devices, which require fast and accurate responses to input and output data changes. We explained how to use a RTOS to implement common control tasks such as switching, modulation, protection, and synchronization. We also showed how to use tools such as critical section, queue, and semaphore to ensure the correctness and efficiency of the software. We illustrated our approach with examples from real-world applications of power electronics devices. The paper aim is to demonstrate how a RTOS can provide a reliable and efficient platform for designing and testing power electronics software.

articleTitle: A New Synthesis Technique of High-Frequency Inductor Equivalent Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The equivalent circuit of a ferrite core inductor in a wide frequency range (0 - 500 MHz) with the separation of the influence of the wire and the influence of the core on the complex resistance of the inductor is presented. The inductor equivalent circuit was built taking into account the physical processes occurring in the inductor: the influence of the wire resistance, the influence of the core material, the mutual influence of the wire and the core material. Its frequency characteristics turned out to be quite close with the measured inductor impedance frequency characteristics in a wide frequency band (0 - 500 MHz). A technique for extracting parameters in presented ferrite core inductor equivalent circuit is shown, which allows you to quickly determine the parameters of the inductor equivalent circuit from the measured inductor impedance frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: Autonomous Power Supply System Based on Gas Turbine Units of the Compressor Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The advantages of using synchronous generators driven by gas turbine compressor set are highlighted. Possible problems and tasks are noted based on already known studies. The article describes a version of the gas turbine compressor set with a permanent magnets synchronous generator and a frequency converter for stabilizing the output voltage and frequency for the needs of an autonomous power supply system. The created simulation model in MATLAB environment with Simulink extension package is considered. The model allowed to research of transient processes in the system of autonomous electric power supply on the basis of synchronous generator on permanent magnets. The results of investigation of the simulation model when changing the load and rotation speed of the generator drive shaft are given. Based on the research, conclusions were drawn. The problem of power quality on the generator stator due to the use of a frequency converter is considered. The invention proposes a version of mitigation negative impact of the frequency converter on the generator at change of the rotor rotation speed, due to the installation of an active rectifier and regulation of its operation using vector control. The results of analysis of THD in generator stator voltage are presented.

articleTitle: USB 3.0 Based Heterogeneous Data High-Speed Transfer Subsystem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Development of a high-speed data transfer subsystem to connect a computer and an external equipment is very relevant for a wide variety of areas - industry, medicine, scientific research and many others. At first glance, modern high-speed interfaces provide all the possibilities to complete the task. In practice, developers face a number of difficulties that prevent the full use of high bandwidth, for example, of USB 3.0 interface. The reasons for these difficulties lie both in the lack of information about the practical experience of using these interfaces, and in the well-known technical complexity of high-speed interfaces implementation. The article presents a method for developing a subsystem that provides high-speed transfer of heterogeneous data using the example of a large-format digital inkjet printer. The development results are formulated, information on the use of the subsystem in commercial products is given.

articleTitle: Development of a Control Algorithm of the Power Converter for Solar Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The power converter for solar photovoltaic is considered, which contains one input choke, two transistors, two diodes and two output capacitors. The phase shift of the switching transistors of such a converter provides a doubling of the ripple frequency of the input choke current. This is due to the relatively small mass and cost of the converter. The use of a solar battery as a primary source of electricity and a three-level output DC/AC converter together with a rechargeable battery as a load determine the tasks of control this power converter. It is necessary that the control system is capable of both stabilizing the output voltage and limiting the output current, and working in the mode of searching for the peak power point of the solar battery. In order to create a control algorithm, a mathematical model of power converter for solar photovoltaic has been developed. The obtained mathematical model allowed to develop a control algorithm for the power converter concerned. A prototype of a power converter with a switching frequency of transistors equals 25 kHz and with an output power of 20 kW has been tested. The results obtained during the development of the control algorithm and testing of the prototype of the PC will be useful both for engineers developing converter equipment and for software engineers developing control for pulse converters.

articleTitle: Study of Human-Machine Interaction Based on Industrial Soft-Type Exoskeletons
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents the results of mathematical modeling the process of lifting the load by the operator equipped with a soft exoskeleton with a controlled system of gravitational load compensation. The device facilitates operations and reduces possible lumbar spine injury risks. The paper presents the calculation scheme of the human-machine system, the assumptions and a mathematical apparatus that allows determining the optimal parameters of a soft exoskeleton elastic element, as well as numerically evaluating the effect of the elastic compensator when performing various movements. Full-scale experiments on lifting loads from the floor in exoskeleton were carried out as part of this research, after which the laws for changing the angle of rotation in the knee and hip joints were obtained. On the basis of the proposed mathematical model of the human-machine system and the results of full-scale experiments, time diagrams of forces and moments in the human-machine system operator-exoskeleton were obtained in the process of lifting the load.

articleTitle: Operation with Auxiliary Devices of Automatics U sing External Computing Resources on Trusted Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The possibility of controlling auxiliary devices of electroautomatics of technological equipment with the use of external computing resources on trusted control systems is considered. The method of identification of the user of technological equipment using a single-board computer and RFID (Radio-Frequency Identification) tags is proposed. For realisation of the specified method the structural scheme of the system of safety control for the machine tool with numerical control on the basis of single-board computer Raspberry Pi and RFID-reader is offered. Based on the structural scheme of the solution, the Architectural model of the access control system software is developed. The access control system connected to the CNC system AxiOMA Control, developed at the Department of Computer Control Systems, FGBOU VO “MSTU “STANKIN”, is implemented in the work.

articleTitle: Comparison of Key Frames of Video Sequences Using the Izhikevich Spiking Neuron
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the important problems in the technical vision of robots and in the tasks of local navigation and global mapping is recognition of robot location, both locally and in a global map. This problem is solved by standard approaches, such as flat possibility maps, three-dimensional maps with LIDAR sensors and stereo pairs, but all them are not always easy and convenient. A method combining the latest approaches to image segmentation without training, image processing tools, and a modified Izhikevich spiking neuron is proposed. The algorithm compares frames of the test video sequence with key frames of the train video sequence shot in the same area as part of initialization and configuration process of the system. The work was carried out under an assumption that all the main areas and positions where camera can be located in work time were captured and processed at the training stage. Object classification mechanism description is deliberately omitted in this work. Final result of the work is an algorithm that matches any keyframe from the train sequence with the best matching frame from the test sequence. By generalization to an arbitrarily large number of key frames in the observed area, an algorithm for global localization in an arbitrarily large area can be obtained.

articleTitle: A Brushless Reversed Monopolar Generator with Longitudinal Flux from Nonsalient Poles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The successful implementation of equipment new technical solutions is inextricably linked with commercial success - one of the aspects of which is the weight and dimensions. In general, there is a direct relationship between the weight, dimensions and cost of equipment. For example, dimensions determine the very possibility of placing generators in shipbuilding, aviation and some other cases. Reducing the dimensions of generators can reduce their cost, facilitate their transportation, and partly increase reliability. For the new generators with longitudinal flux, mass and outer dimensions are determined by the features of their <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\mathrm{D}$</tex> design. A reversed design of generator with longitudinal flux is proposed, which make it possible to more fully use the entire volume of its stator and reduce the outer dimensions. All theoretical theses are confirmed on a model using finite elements.

articleTitle: The Problem of Renewable Energy Sources and Market Mechanisms in Various Energy Systems in the Era of Global Crises
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The energy crisis, which began in the third quarter of 2021 and continues in 2023, has demonstrated the instability and fragility of the European Union (EU) energy system being built on the basis of renewable energy sources (RES), decentralization, market pricing mechanisms and accelerated deindustrialization. However, this situation is observed not only in the EU, but also in Asia (in Japan and Singapore). It is the high share of renewable energy sources in the generating structure of the EU leads to the fact that prices can be abnormally high or ultra-low, which demonstrates the failure in the reforms of the energy transition to a new energy order, where the stake is not on stable, predictable, high-quality and affordable generation, but on the basis of intermittent, expensive, unstable and poor-quality generation of solar and wind power plants. However, in times of crisis, governments around the world begin to limit the pricing of energy and electricity in order to reduce the impact of the energy crisis on life. State regulation is necessary to overcome the current crisis, despite the reforms of 2009–2010, which have shown their unviability in the context of a complex systemic decline that affects different spheres of life. The recession of the world economy, oil, gas, energy, inflation, food, political and social crises form our harsh reality - the Era of Global Crises. Whose echoes were recorded back in 2019, long before the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. When all physical indicators showed a contraction in the global economy. The energy crisis and the mistake in the strategic planning of energy security create the conditions under which the European Union will lose its premium position for producing countries in the current decade. And the migration of industry to the United States and Asia shortens the window of opportunity to overcome crises. The only way to overcome the crisis is to switch to nuclear energy, which requires political will and strategic planning.

articleTitle: Passive Cooling of PV Modules by Thermoelectric Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Today, renewable energy sources are used all over the world. Their importance and usefulness is known to everyone. One of the most widely used is solar energy. But there is a problem that significantly reduces their efficiency, it is the high surface temperature of photovoltaic modules. When the surface temperature increases by each degree more than 25 °C, the power of the modules decreases by an average of 0.3 %. The paper considers the possibility of using thermoelectric elements for the design of a passive cooling system for photovoltaic modules. An existing study on the cooling system is given. A modeling of the cooling system was carried out in order to find out the effectiveness of this cooling method. The possible surface temperatures of the photovoltaic module are determined when using a passive cooling system based on thermoelectric elements. The results of the study will assess the feasibility of using such a cooling system in regions with a hot climate and the possible increase in the efficiency of photovoltaic modules.

articleTitle: Development and Application of New Data Processing Algorithms for the Software of Modern Atomic Emission Spectrometers when Examining Steels and Alloys
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents the results of applying the unique method developed by the authors. It is related to solving one of the most vital tasks faced by metallurgical industry, namely, determining and control of impurity content in metals and alloys. As a rule, in industrial conditions this task is achieved using emission spectrometers with charge-coupled devices in their recording systems. The new method takes into account the exact value of plasma background radiation at the location of the analysis line as well as the nonlinear “third” element impact, and also extends the dynamic range of recording devices, which gives the opportunity to calibrate spectrometers using two standard samples and to analyze alloys on the same basis within a single “global methodology”. Tested on mass-produced Russian spectrometers, the developed method has proved successful.

articleTitle: XLPE Cable Line Thermal Regime in the Power Supply System of a Metallurgical Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of the required thermal regime of ca-ble lines does not reach the end, although it pays great attention, and is also widely applicable explicitly, but is practically not used to verify a mathematical model with experimental data. In this work, the mathematical thermal model of cable is being verified with experimental data; as a result of this work, they are a novel-ty of a real-life system-forming fiber and its mathematical model of impact. The work focuses on the operating cable voltage lines of 110 kV brand APvVng 1x500/120 of the system-forming power supply network of the substation of blind input 110/10 kV and above the design features of cable lines, a thermal model is pro-posed and thermal regime calculations are implemented. The results of thermal mode simulation calculations must be compared with the results of studies of thermal mode measurements with a thermal imager at the same load. On the basis of experi-mental studies and the results of mathematical modeling, studies are proposed to detect the required thermal area. Studies and processing of experimental data were carried out using a Fluke Tis 10 Thermal Imager, the study of models by the calculation method. The result and practical shooting are the possibility of using a mathematical model of the thermal regime when collecting software tools for controlling the thermal regime.

articleTitle: New Circuit Solutions of AC Voltage Regulators as a Soft-Start Device for Asynchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Asynchronous motors can be started both directly and smoothly. One or another method depending on the torque is used. But the need for a soft start significantly exceeds than the direct one, since in this case the engine life increases. This problem can be solved in several ways, both by frequency start-up and voltage regulation. Several variants of AC voltage regulators are considered in this paper. We can say that all of them have become the development of a thyristor AC voltage regulator with counter-parallel connection of thyristors, further we will call this scheme classical. The main problem of such a scheme can be considered a poor form of output voltage and current curves, which are supplied to the load, namely, the motor. It can be solved by dividing the output voltage into zones. This became possible with the help of several secondary windings of the transformer or with the help of a capacitor divider. Two new circuits were proposed based on the second one with a reduced number of semiconductor switches and with the combined connection of capacitors. The paper presents the modeling results in the PSIM program, as well as an assessment of the output voltage regulation range and voltage quality with a different number of used control zones.

articleTitle: Various Poles Numbers 800 kW Synchronous Wind Generators for Arctic Region
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For the development of Russia Arctic region, wind power plants of domestic production are required. The article analyzes the parameters of 800 kW permanent magnets synchronous generators for the Arctic region. The generators provide for the magnetic flux concentration and the use of a concentrated stator winding. During the investigation, an original calculation program was used, generators variants with a different number of poles were analyzed when the air gap value changed. The influence of variable values on the generators parameters and characteristics is estimated. Numerical studies of a two-dimensional electromagnetic field by the finite element method for various operating modes are performed. Generators provide for the possibility of working with a single-stage gearbox in places with different estimated wind speeds and are considered in the work as a basic promising option for wind power in northern latitudes.

articleTitle: Methodology for Evaluating the Efficiency Selection of Automatic Circuit Recloser Dead Time Settings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper considers modeling of processes occurring in the cycle of three-phase automatic circuit recloser (ACR) on the overhead line in order to determine the optimal duration of dead time pause. All calculations were performed in the program complex ATPDraw, which took into account both electromagnetic transients using the arc model and electromechanical processes taking into account the intragroup motion of generator rotors. A channel model of a vertical arc stabilized by upward convective gas flows was used as an electric arc model. In addition to three-phase reclosure, the case of single-phase reclosure operation on a 500 kV transmission line was also considered.

articleTitle: Heat Transfer of Modified Surfaces with Dispersed Coolant Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The authors conducted a study of the cooling of modified surfaces by a dispersed coolant flow. Surface modification was carried out by three different methods: structure knurling, electron beam, and hole drilling. Three series of experiments were carried out for each of the surfaces at different coolant parameters. The excess pressure of the coolant at the nozzle inlet was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(1.5-3.5)\cdot 10^{5}$</tex> Pa), the mass flow rate of the coolant (distilled water) was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(4.0-6.0)\cdot 10^{-3}$</tex> kg/s, the irrigation density varied within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(4.2-6.2) \text{kg}/(\mathrm{m}^{2}\cdot \mathrm{s})$</tex>. The dependences of the heat flux density and the heat transfer coefficient were compared for both modified and unmodified surfaces. For the calculated thermophysical quantities, the corresponding graphic dependences were obtained.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Method for Determining the Frequency Responses of Synchronous Generators from Short Circuit Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The main propositions of the more accurated method of experimental determination of conductivity frequency responses from the side of the stator winding of rhe synchronous machine taking into account the rotor multi-loops are stated. The method is based on an analytical description of the generalized current vector in the stator winding in the time variation, taking into account the phase shifts between the individual free components of the periodic current at the initial moment of the transient process. The proposed method will allow to accurate the method regulated by the International Electrotechnical Commis-sion IEC 34–4 and the IEEE 115 standard.

articleTitle: Automation of Detection of Insulation Defects of High-Voltage Electrical Equipment by Partial Discharges Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The method of partial discharges is used for diagnose the insulation of high-voltage electrical equipment and prevent accidents. For register and interpret the characteristics of partial discharges in order to predict the development of insulation defects, multi-range sensors of electromagnetic radiation are used with a registration frequency in the frequency band of the order of gigahertz. In turn, to simulate the pre-breakdown situation, special standard sources of partial discharges with known characteristics are often used. The presented work is devoted to the study of the criteria for a pre-breakdown situation, the calculation of S parameters, spectrum characteristics, schemes for registering partial discharges in the gigahertz range for automatic recognition of insulation defects in high-voltage electrical equipment by the characteristics of partial discharges.

Author Keywords: diagnostics of high-voltage electrical insulators in ultra-high frequency radiation range
diagnostics of high-voltage electrical insulators in ultra-width frequency radiation range

articleTitle: Identification of the Development Cogeneration Potential in Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Energy development around the world is aimed at improving the energy efficiency of energy production. One of the well-known ways to improve energy efficiency is to increase the share of combined production. It is possible to increase the share of combined production by transforming the boiler house into a mini-CHPP, as an object of joint generation of heat and electricity. However, in municipalities or cities, the efficiency of introducing cogeneration technologies through the reconstruction of boiler houses is not the same. It is largely determined by the ratio of production of heat and electricity, the level of development of cogeneration now, resource sufficiency, and others. Now, there are no comprehensive methods that allow choosing a municipality that has a significant potential for the introduction of cogeneration technologies. This work aims to develop and justify a methodology for multi-criteria analysis and ranking of cities from the standpoint of the potential for improving energy efficiency by transforming boiler houses into mini-CHPPs. Based on the developed methodology, an analysis of the cities of Russia was carried out and their ranking was carried out from the standpoint of the potential for the development of cogeneration.

articleTitle: Universal Model for Studying Characteristics of a Brushless DC Motor with Discrete Switching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A universal model presented in this paper allows studying characteristics of a brushless DC motor with discrete switching. The description of the mathematical model in the form of analytical expressions takes into account the discrete switching of the BLDC motor phases. From analytical expressions, a generalized equation is obtained that is valid for all cycles of discrete switching. Based on it, a universal mathematical model is built. Using the obtained equations, we perform a simulation of the DVM100.22 motor produced by the Zlatoust Design Office of Mechatronics and present the results of the VisSim simulation of currents. The obtained simulation results coincide with theoretical concepts and confirm the adequacy of the system of current equations proposed in the paper. The results presented in the work refine and develop the provisions given in other works and can be used for more accurate simulation and analysis of the BLDC motor operation. The resulting mathematical model was developed to study various modes of BLDC motors with discrete switching.

articleTitle: Greenhouse Complex Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Greenhouse complexes focused on the cultivation of tomatoes and cucumbers are enterprises with an energy-intensive technological process. The main primary energy resources needed to grow these vegetables are natural gas, electricity and water. These energy resources are used in the systems of electricity and heat supply of the greenhouse complex. The volume and cost of heat and electricity affect the cost and quantity of products. The share of energy costs is about 40% in the cost of tomatoes and cucumbers. Technical solutions are proposed to improve the economic efficiency of energy supply. To achieve the goal, it is proposed to increase the energy efficiency of the production of heat and electricity in the energy supply system. The use of a cogeneration plant using gas piston technology allows this to be achieved. The economic feasibility of using cogeneration in the heat and power supply system of the greenhouse complex is shown.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Digital Current and Voltage Measuring Transformers 6–10 Kv for Single-Phase Earth Fault Location
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Medium-voltage distribution networks (6–10 kV in Russia) are the largest and at the same time the most problematic link in the power supply system of consumers. Improving the reliability of medium-voltage overhead distribution networks is still an urgent task. The task of improving the reliability of networks is directly related to the improvement of algorithms and devices for single-phase earth fault (SPEF) location. Researches of Ivanovo State Power Engineering University (ISPEU) and an industrial partner developed automated power control and metering station (APCMS) based on digital measurement voltage and current transformers (DCVT). APCMS contains the function of detecting a damaged section (branch) of a 6–10 kV overhead power transmission line (OTL). In the installed APCMS sample the function works in the test mode, so additional studies of DCVT and APCMS for the tasks of fault location are relevant. The article presents the methodology for determining the faulted section in case of SPEF, considers the features of application of 6–10 kV DCVT and APCMS for determining the faulted section, and also presents the methodology for additional studies of DCVT during SPEFs, including arc faults.

Author Keywords: automated power control and metering station

articleTitle: Features of Alternative Power Supply of Weather Stations for Monitoring the Condition of the Roadway
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the winter period there is a task of timely control over the condition of the roadway. The formation of snow and ice on intercity roads increases the likelihood of accidents. One of the options to reduce accidents is to control the condition of the roadway and climatic parameters that lead to these natural phenomena with the help of weather stations with a set of different sensors. The location of weather stations along the roads will allow to control the parameters of the condition of the roadway in a timely manner and take measures to parry critical situations. The paper discusses options for alternative power supply of weather stations located away from power grids along intercity roads. The paper considers the possibilities of powering weather stations for condition monitoring from the three-phase grid, powering from solar panels and powering from wind installations. It is proposed to apply a complex power supply to realize the uninterrupted operation of the weather station in winter

articleTitle: Friction Mixing Welding Process Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the development and research of an experimental system for monitoring the parameters of the friction-mixing welding process (FSW) to obtain welded joints according to specified technological parameters. To implement this system, a technical specification has been developed, including the necessary requirements for an experimental installation, monitoring and control system; equipment has been developed for fixing workpieces and installing sensors. The developed monitoring system includes a measuring system (sensors), signal converters and software for displaying and recording readings. Experimental studies on the FSW of steel, aluminum and copper with elements of the monitoring system were carried out.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Learning Application for the Fault Localization in the Medium Voltage Power Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Nowadays the problem of fault localization in power distribution grids still remains important and actual. Whereas classic approaches face several difficulties, machine learning based methods are assumed to be prospective. The following study proposes a variety of a neural network fault locator for phase-to-ground fault and phase-to-phase fault types occurred typically in grids, although this method has not yet been researched sufficiently. The ability of method to handle uncertainty of power distribution grid parameters and fault parameters is demonstrated. The study also analyzes which data should be collected to achieve better results for different problem statements and different conditions of uncertainty and shows how to preprocess data and how to adjust correctly and train neural network.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of an Open Arc to Study Arcing Faults in Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Computer modeling of an open electric arc is an actual task, because it is necessary to consider various cases accompanied by occurrence of arc discharge when creating the digital doubles of a wide range of electrical installations. The article presents a short description of the computer model of an open AC arc with changing geometric parameters. The model was created by the authors in the COMSOL Multiphysics software package. The results of the calculation and their comparison with experimental data are given. The correctness of the created model is proved. The created model allows to calculate the distribution of the temperature field of the arc channel, as well as to obtain the time dependences of the current, intensity and radius of arcing in electrical networks, depending on the thermophysical properties of the plasma, the scheme and parameters of the external circuit.

articleTitle: Impact of Service Life Duration on Electric Losses in Power Transformers: An Analytical Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Transformers of metal plants include numerous devices past their rater service life. Their ongoing operation is made possible by regular maintenance and backup. Defining the transformer replacement sequence is a relevant problem due to the high costs of such equipment. Another important problem is cutting electricity losses depending on the actual efficiency that reduces over the long service life. In the majority of papers, the transformer power parameter data is based on the no-load and short-circuit losses calculated using the rated values. These parameters change over time, thus, such calculations cannot be accurate. The authors suggest an efficiency assessment method based on experimental measurements and calculations using the obtained results. An experiment was conducted to assess the electric losses in the transformer that has been in operation for over 55 years. An increased steel loss and a 0.5% efficiency reduction were confirmed, which are not critical. Accounting for the electric loss changes is deemed feasible when the service life of a transformer is over 20 years. To prolong the service life, the authors suggest using online technical condition monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Smart Parking Systems: a Review on User Interface Features and Real World Examples
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Smart parking can be used as a component of smart cities or practically in any kind of city. It aims to improve the efficiency and sustainability of urban transportation systems by using technology to manage parking resources. This article provides an overview of the different components of smart parking systems. We talk about different sensors, data analysis, occupancy detection, and dynamic pricing used in smart parking systems. This work demonstrates the challenges and opportunities of implementing smart parking in different cities. Additionally, the paper provides the flow of data within these systems. The article concludes with a consideration of the future of smart parking and its role in the overall development of smart cities.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar Thermal Power Plant Potential in Australia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: With the world increasingly shifting towards clean energy, Australia has the potential to be a major player in the renewable energy industry, specially in the solar energy sector. The use of solar thermal energy in Australia has a lot of promise. One promising concept with solar thermal energy that has gained attention in recent years is hybrid solar thermal power plants. A hybrid solar thermal power plant doesn't suffer inefficiencies from when there is insufficient sunlight to generate steam. This work presents a comprehensive examination of solar thermal technology's applications in the energy industry. It offers insights into the current state of Australia's energy sector, including its unique climatic attributes, and explores the possibilities of integrating hybrid solar technologies within the country. The study also delves into the analysis of an Integrated Solar Combined Cycle (ISCC) plant model utilizing parabolic trough collectors and evaluates the efficiency of this hybrid solar thermal power plant. To simulate the combined utilization of a combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) plant and a solar steam generator for power generation THERMOFLEX software was utilized.

articleTitle: Use of Synchronized Vector Measurements Technology for Perform Relay Protection Functions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Consider the use of synchrophasor technologies at a digital substation of the fourth type, as a replacement for Sampled Values (SV) signals. Consider additions to the standard set of synchrophasor signals necessary for the operation of various relay protections at a digital substation. Perform an analysis of the accuracy of calculating the synchrophasor when the frequency of the controlled current and voltage changes relative to the nominal value, when higher harmonics appear in the measured signal. Develop a pre-computation technique for relay protection algorithms. METHODS. When solving the problem, the method of calculating the total measurement error of the synchrophasor TVE (Total Vector Error) was used - a value that characterizes the deviation of the amplitude and phase of the measured vector from their specified values. CONCLUSION. The use of synchrophasor signals with the necessary additions for the operation of relay protection reduces the load on the digital network of the digital substation, simplifies the operation of relay protection algorithms. Calculations have shown that the measurement errors of synchrophasor do not go beyond the specified parameters. The proposed methods of precomputation allow to speed up the work of relay protection algorithms.

articleTitle: The Application of Technical Vision for Automation of Measuring Cycles in CNC Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article describes a possible method for automating measurements on CNC machines that support measurements in semi-automatic mode by calling parameterized measurement cycles. The proposed method is based on the use of a vision system integrated with a CNC system and approximately determining the geometric parameters and coordinates of the workpiece to fill in the parameters of the measuring cycle. The requirements for the installation of the system hardware on the equipment are formulated. The methodology of measurement using the system is described. Algorithms for obtaining and software processing of images are described, including recognition of the area with the workpiece, automatic correction of brightness and contrast of input images and determination of the contours of the workpieces and their parameters. An algorithm for processing data on the obtained contours for calculating the approximate dimensions of the workpiece relative to the marks previously applied to the machine desktop is also described. The interaction of the vision system with the CNC system is described to run a template control program that causes a filled measuring cycle to determine the position and dimensions of the workpiece accurately. The prototype of the vision system is installed on real equipment.

articleTitle: Methodology for Building a CNC System Based on a Memory-Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of building a control system based on a memory-oriented architecture. The analysis of processors of various manufacturers and the analysis of existing hardware architectures of control systems was carried out. Their advantages, disadvantages, areas of application are revealed. The architecture of a memory-oriented control system is proposed: separate modules of the control system are allocated, which are expediently placed on different processors. A technique for building a CNC system based on a memory- oriented architecture has been formed, consisting of the following steps: studying the classical architecture, decomposing the system into components, selecting hardware components of the CNC system, distributing components by hardware modules, and building a communication environment based on messaging. The use of this approach makes it possible to develop high-speed control systems by distributing the computations performed over several processors.

Author Keywords: hardware architecture of the control system

articleTitle: Distant Light Sensor for Performing Ultra-Short-Term Forecasting of Solar Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Compared to other types of energy, solar energy is one of the most environmentally friendly types. In modern realities, the introduction, usage, and integration of renewable energy sources into energy systems are growing every year. However, the output from photovoltaic (PV) systems remains unstable due to the dynamic changes in solar radiation caused by the rapid movement of clouds across the sky. As a result, accurate short-term solar radiation forecasting has become crucial for ensuring the efficiency and safety of power system operations. The objective of this article is to provide a comprehensive overview of ultra-short-term forecasting of solar energy, including the importance of this type of forecasting, the current state of the technology, our team's project and opportunities for future research and development. By the end of the article, readers should have a solid understanding of the fundamentals of ultra-short-term forecasting for solar energy and the potential implications for the future of renewable energy. It delves into existing approaches, highlighting their strengths and limitations. Moreover, the article introduces an innovative project developed by our team in the field of solar radiation prediction.

articleTitle: Influence of Interdependence of Power Sources in Emergency Modes on Industrial Consumers Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Short-term power supply disruptions in the external industrial consumers' power supply networks are associated with significant damage caused by complex and continuous technological processes shutdowns. Those can be minimized if the design stage features a developed and implemented efficient emergency measures for the external and internal power supply systems. The interdependence of power sources in the emergency modes significantly impacts the power supply reliability of industrial consumers. The article discusses ways to minimize the interdependence of power sources, as well as the features of selecting the type and characteristics of excitation systems and automatic excitation control devices (AEC) of generating plants (GP) at distributed generation (DG) facilities when they function as part of the internal power supply systems of industrial consumers.

Author Keywords: short-term and long-term power supply interruptions

articleTitle: Assessment of the State of Complex Technical Objects Based on the Analysis of Time Series Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of estimating the state of complex technical objects based on the analysis of time series anomalies is considered. It is shown that to solve this problem it is necessary to use time series of large dimensionality, which have a number of features. Such features include: noise accumulation, false correlation and random endogeneity. In this regard, the analysis of experimental series obtained as a result of continuous long-term observations requires the application of special methods of artificial intelligence, which can improve the results of decision-making in poorly structured situations through machine learning. One of such methods, which has recently become widespread, is time series anomaly analysis. The study of methods for analyzing time series anomalies allowed us to establish that the most adapted for working with contextual anomalies is a group of spectral methods.
