We propose a method for analyzing time series anomalies based on the decomposition of the time characteristics of the studied objects into a spectral series by a special basis of exponential functions.

articleTitle: Elements of the Smart Geometrical Control Technology for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The authors propose a multimodal control system for an unmanned quadcopter integrating various information input, processing, and transmission methods, as well as the methods of geometrical and smart control. The smart control component is associated with the processing of voice and gesture commands recognized using artificial neural networks of deep learning. The geometrical components are associated with routing, solving problems of trajectory and target following, as well as video camera aiming. It is also a minimum-time problem. The authors provide a generic design of the control system. Controlling the on-board camera plays a significant role. The video camera monitors a ground-based (moving or stationary) object, and it can switch to the point determined by the operator. To forecast the movement of the target, the authors use an artificial neural network (ANN) with a new s-parabola activation function that facilitates fast learning and calculation of the set function. To model the control during the mission, the authors built and analyzed a dynamic control model as an automatic control system based on transfer functions. During the flight, the system experiences wind loads that hinder precise control and camera aiming for ground-based targets. The system is modeled in MATLAB and Simulink software.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of a Flotation Water Treatment System for Attack Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper proposes an approach to the development of a simulation model of an industrial flotation water treatment system designed for solving problems of attack modeling and evaluation. The model provides a mechanism for generating initial data on the functioning of the system through using a graph of generalized system states. The system states are formed based on the readings of the system sensors and the current configuration of the actuators. An analytical model of attacks on a flotation water treatment system, including a list of relevant attacks and their characteristics has been produced. In the forthcoming process of studying attacks, the proposed model will significantly reduce the impact of organizational and technical difficulties that arise in full-fledge natural modeling of attacks directly on the physical implementation of the water treatment system. In addition, the sequences of transitions between states will make it possible to form scenarios both for the normal functioning of the system and in case of attacks. Such scenarios could be used to obtain estimates of the attack feasibility on large samples of initial data, which would be considerably difficult to fulfill in the framework of a full-fledge physical model.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Costs of Stand-Alone Monitoring Systems in the Arctic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the approaches to configuring an off-grid renewable power supply for a gas production monitoring system in terms of life cycle cost minimization. Based on a real case operated for more than 15 years in Yamburg, Yamal-Nenets autonomous district, Russia, we have analyzed the power supply interruptions and operational expenditures (OPEX). We considered several alternative power supply layouts to improve both technical and economic performance. While solar panels have shown stunning reliability, wind turbines failures in harsh Arctic climate are driving power supply reliability decrease and OPEX increase. Fuel cells are suggested as a substitution for wind turbines. As a result, a possibility for TCO reduction by multifold has been shown.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Forecasting Technologies for Icing Events in Overhead Power Line Wires
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Icing on overhead power line wires can cause significant problems for power companies, as it can lead to power outages and damage to equipment. Accurate forecasting and monitoring of icing events can help power grid companies to prepare for and mitigate the impact of these events. In recent years, advances in meteorology and remote sensing technology have made it possible to predict icing events with increasing accuracy. This report paper will explore the methods and techniques used in forecasting icing events in OHL wires, including the use of weather models, remote sensing technologies, and machine learning algorithms. The paper will also discuss the challenges and limitations of current forecasting methods and suggest possible areas for future research and development. By providing a comprehensive overview of the current state of forecasting technology for icing events in OHL wires, this report aims to contribute to the ongoing efforts to improve the reliability and safety of the power grid.

articleTitle: Determination of the Optimal Configuration of Solar PV Power Plants and Wind Farms in the United Energy System of Myanmar
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Integration of wind farms and solar PV power plants into the united energy system (UES) into operational dispatch energy complexes leads to an increase in the reliability of electric power generation, smoothing the daily and seasonal unevenness of electricity generation, etc. The paper describes the methodology developed by the authors for determining the optimal energy complex configuration, which enables the most efficient utilization of the asynchrony in the supply of wind and solar resources to the individual sites of wind farms and solar PV power plants. The problem at hand falls within the realm of multi- criteria optimization and can be resolved by iterating through all potential options, assessing their significance using the rank-based method. The practical applicability of the developed methodology is demonstrated at the site of the Republic of Myanmar united energy system by the example of the energy complex consisting of two solar PV power plants with a total capacity of 60 MW, onshore wind farm with a capacity of 33 MW and an offshore wind farm with a capacity of 32 MW. The locations and capacities of the solar PV power plants and the onshore wind farm were taken from the long-term development plan of the Myanmar united energy system, and, accordingly, the offshore wind farms were selected by the authors. It is shown that due to the asynchrony of the wind and solar resources inflow to the sites of the considered wind farms and solar PV power plants for the optimal configuration of the energy complex share of the electric power generated with 95% probability is 4,7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of the total installed capacity of the energy complex.

articleTitle: Assessment of Impact Magnitude of Supply Voltage and Length of Transmission Line Have on Absolute Error at Calculation of Active Power Losses in the Power Supply System at its Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The research aimed at developing methods for calculating losses in the equipment of power supply systems used to transmit electrical power to the end user, which take into account the impact of various parameters, remain relevant. Thus, a method was proposed for calculating the cumulative losses in the equipment of the power supply system, which, unlike the known methods in which losses are calculated separately by components and by the type of equipment, takes into account the total of the elements of the power supply system and the load associated with the general operation mode. The article sets up the objective to assess the impact the magnitude of the supply voltage and the length of the power transmission line have on the absolute error in calculating losses according to the proposed method and using the method of calculating losses separately by components and by the type of equipment against the data on losses obtained with a mathematical model of the power supply system. To substantiate the range of changes in the supply voltage value, the authors analyze the total of data on its change obtained as a result of measurement on the bus sections with a rated voltage of 6 (10) kV substations supplying power to distribution urban grids, large administrative facilities and industrial enterprises. The analysis results show that for grids with a rated voltage of 6 (10) kV, both negative and positive voltage deviations do not exceed 10%, which corresponds to the requirement of GOST 32144–2013.

Author Keywords: length of the power transmission line 6 (10) k V

articleTitle: Development of a Procedure for Evaluating and Ranking the Reliability and Priority of Repairs for Electrical Equipment in the Oil Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, domestic oil production enterprises (OPE) are actively using risk-based management of submersible electrical equipment (SEE) as the main production assets. First of all, this is determined by the natural quantitative growth of SEE and, accordingly, information about its parameters. Nevertheless, information about the state of the SEE is not fully taken into account either in general, in the current management of the SEE modes, or in the planning of repairs, in particular. Most of all, this is manifested in determining the risk of emergency failures of electric submersible installations (ESI), taking into account the criteria for managing the conditions and the technical and economic efficiency of SEE. A complex indicator is proposed for ranking objects in the SEE inventory based on information about their reliability in determining the risks of emergency failures. Thanks to this, priorities in the planning of repairs and the management of the operating modes of the SEE can be set.

Author Keywords: submersible electrical installations for oil production

articleTitle: Design of the Improved Electrical and Technological Modes Control Algorithms for Various Classes of EAFs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents the results of theoretical and experimental research on the development and improved algorithms and automatic control systems implementation for existing metallurgical furnaces, such as electric arc furnaces (EAFs) and ladle furnaces (LF) electrical modes, which are based on the use of information about higher harmonics of voltages and currents of electric arcs. The use of these algorithms and control systems provides an improvement in the time, energy and technological performance of the EAF and LF. It became possible due to the units electrical modes dynamic adaptation, determined by the on-load tap-changer stage of the furnace transformer and additional reactor (if any), as well as the number of the operating curve in the process of melting the metal charge in Chipboard or out-of-furnace processing of liquid steel in LF. Also, the paper presents the results of the usage of improved control system algorithms implemented in the existing EAF and LF of various classes and capacities operating at metallurgical enterprises.

articleTitle: Using a Rotating Magnetic Field for Milk Pasteurization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: We consider the energy-efficient milk pasteurization plant using an induction heating method. It is capable to provide the necessary milk temperature (from 65 to 95 o C) and uniform heating of the entire volume of milk. The plant is based on the stator of an asynchronous three-phase motor with a modified rotor. The know-how of the plant is that the rotating magnetic field of the stator pumps milk and inductively heats it. The modeling of thermal and hydrodynamic processes occurring in the plant confirmed the possibility of its use in the withstanding mode and in the flow mode of preheating. We proposed an algorithm of calculating the plant parameters to ensure the given temperature regime of the pasteurizer. With the help of the developed computational model of thermal and hydrodynamic processes in the considered plant, we formulated the requirements for the speed of rotation of the rotor and the power of heat generation in it. When implementing the electromagnetic model, the variants of the structural design of the elements of the heating system with the different number of blades and their different position on the rotor shaft were considered. The optimal parameters of the plant and the optimal current density were found. The considered plant can be recommended for creating the milk pasteurizer based on it after the detailed study of individual design elements before the beginning of the serial production.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Optimum Value of the Voltage for a Field Substation Equipped with an On-Load Tap-Changing Voltage Controller, Taking Into Account the Features of Frequency Converters of Submersible Pump Control Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The analysis of the outgoing line of an electrical substation equipped with a load control device has been carried out. Mathematical expressions are defined that can determine the speed of rotation of the shaft of a submersible electric motor powered by a frequency converter with a variation of the input voltage. Formulas are also given for determining the active and reactive power consumed by a submersible asynchronous electric motor and losses in a step-up transformer, taking into account the characteristics of frequency converters. The possibility of using the obtained analytical expressions in the algorithm for calculating the optimal value of the field substation voltage, which provides the least loss of electricity during mechanized oil production, taking into account the possibilities of voltage regulation by a load control device, is considered. An example of calculating the optimal voltage value for an outgoing power transmission line feeding producing wells is given for two variants of the implementation of electrical complexes: without frequency converters and with a frequency converter in one of the control stations. The influence of frequency converters on the optimal value of the field substation voltage and power loss is considered.

articleTitle: Considering Transient Analysis Results in Probabilistic Calculations of Industrial Consumers' Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: When designing internal and external power supply systems for industrial consumers, one conducts the probabilistic calculations of power supply reliability. To identify all possible short-term power supply failures, we need to consider the results of external power supply system transients' analysis. Various circuit-mode situations should be taken into account, including the repair network circuits, the cases of nearby and remote short circuits, unsuccessful overhead lines automatic re-activation (AR), causing significant damage and losses. The article considers three stages of transient calculations and approaches to assessing the aftermath of emergency disturbances for consumers. The results of the transients' calculations should serve as a basis developing the sets of emergency measures in the industrial consumers external and internal power supply system; such measures should also be evaluated for effectiveness. The paper also substantiates the necessity of accounting for both typical and extra-typical emergency disturbances during transient calculation. It also suggests approaches towards the provision of the reliability of hazardous technological processes power supply by means of the organizational and technical measures implemented.
